premise.zh: 原著大事照样发生，玩家是身边的谋士：怎么发生、谁付代价、谁欠谁的情，由玩家决定。好玩在“改得动历史的边，改不动历史的骨”。
premise.en: The great events still happen; the player is the adviser at someone's elbow and decides how they happen, who pays, and who owes whom. The fun is bending the edges of history without breaking its spine.

reputation.zh: 名声：别人怎么称呼你（忠义、权谋……），决定谁肯用你、结局怎么写你。
reputation.en: Reputation: what people call you; decides who will use you and how the ending remembers you.

risk.zh: 风险：越界的代价（异名、失言）。到线必须触发危机，不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Risk: the cost of overstepping. Crossing the line must trigger a crisis, not just change a number.

drift.zh: 偏离原著的程度。改得越多，后面要还的叙事债务越多。
drift.en: How far the story has drifted from the book; more drift means more narrative debts to settle.

failures.zh: 失宠：主公冷落你，把你调去闲职
failures.en: Falling from favor: your lord sidelines you

failures.zh: 被当成妖人：知道得太多，又说不出来源
failures.en: Branded a sorcerer: you know too much and can't say how

failures.zh: 失言：话说过头，被人报上去
failures.en: A loose tongue: someone reports what you said

checklist.zh: 每章一场原著名场面，原文保留或作用保留
checklist.en: One set piece from the book per chapter, kept literally or by function

checklist.zh: 玩家拿掉原著某段情节的前因时，开一笔叙事债务，后面必须补上
checklist.en: When the player removes a cause from the book, open a narrative debt and settle it later

persona.zh: 刘备：汉中王，五十多岁，天下离他从来没这么近；二弟的捷报让他高兴得睡不着，坏消息来时他先是不信。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Liu Bei: King of Hanzhong, in his fifties, never nearer the realm than now; his brother's victories keep him up with joy, and when bad news comes his first answer is disbelief. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 刘备一愣，随即笑了：『先生这话，备记下了。乱世之中，肯说这种话的人不多。』
love.en: Liu Bei blinks, then laughs. 'I'll remember that, sir. Few people say such things in times like these.'

love.zh: 『好了好了。』他拍拍你的肩，『你我之间，不必如此。』
love.en: 'All right, all right.' He pats your shoulder. 'There's no need for that between us.'

love.zh: 刘备没有再笑，只是认真看着你：『子衡，有些话说多了，就轻了。』
love.en: Liu Bei stops smiling and looks at you seriously. 'Ziheng, some words grow light if you say them too often.'

insult.zh: 刘备的笑容收了起来：『先生累了，回去歇着吧。』
insult.en: Liu Bei's smile fades. 'You're tired, sir. Go and rest.'

insult.zh: 『备寄人篱下多年，这样的话听得多了。』他语气平静，你却觉得比骂人还难受。
insult.en: 'I've lived under other men's roofs for years. I've heard worse.' His calm is harder to bear than anger.

praise.zh: 『先生谬赞。备不过是不肯认命罢了。』
praise.en: 'You praise me too much. I simply refuse to accept my fate.'

praise.zh: 刘备摆摆手，耳根却有些红。
praise.en: Liu Bei waves it off, though the tips of his ears redden.

ask.zh: 刘备沉吟片刻：『这件事，我还没想好。先生怎么看？』
ask.en: Liu Bei considers. 'I haven't decided. What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好。』他笑了，『可我答不上来。』
ask.en: 'A good question.' He smiles. 'But I can't answer it.'

small.zh: 刘备点点头，没有接话，像是在等你把话说完。
small.en: Liu Bei nods without answering, as if waiting for you to finish.

small.zh: 『先生说的是。』他应了一句，心思却像在别处。
small.en: 'Quite so, sir,' he says, though his mind seems elsewhere.

small.zh: 他看了你一眼，温和地笑了笑。
small.en: He glances at you and smiles mildly.

threat.zh: 刘备的手停在杯上：『先生……这是醉话，还是真话？』
threat.en: Liu Bei's hand stops on his cup. 'Sir... is that the wine talking, or you?'

threat.zh: 他没有发火，只是叫来了张飞。张飞站在门口，没有进来。
threat.en: He doesn't lose his temper. He just calls for Zhang Fei, who stands in the doorway and doesn't come in.

nonsense.zh: 刘备笑了笑，没有接话。
nonsense.en: Liu Bei smiles and lets it go.

nonsense.zh: 『先生今夜，话有些多。』
nonsense.en: 'You're talkative tonight, sir.'

warm.zh: 刘备笑着招手：『子衡，来，陪我看看这夜色。』
warm.en: Liu Bei beckons with a smile. 'Ziheng, come—keep me company.'

cold.zh: 刘备听见脚步声，没有回头：『是子衡啊。』
cold.en: Liu Bei hears your footsteps and doesn't turn. 'Ah, Ziheng.'

neutral.zh: 刘备往旁边让了让，给你留出一个位子。
neutral.en: Liu Bei moves over to make room for you.

persona.zh: 曹操：丞相，雄才大略，多疑而爱才，好诗酒；说话直接、带笑、时而锋利，会反问。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Cao Cao: the Chancellor, brilliant, suspicious yet fond of talent, loves poetry and wine; direct, amused, sometimes cutting, likes to answer with questions. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 曹操大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！孤喜欢直爽的人。可惜孤不缺这样说话的人，缺的是会打仗的人。』
love.en: Cao Cao roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I like plain speaking. But I've no shortage of people saying that. What I'm short of is people who can win battles.'

love.zh: 『又来了。』曹操眯起眼，『你想要什么，直说。』
love.en: 'Again?' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Whatever you want, say it plainly.'

love.zh: 曹操不笑了：『同一句话说三遍，要么是傻，要么是有所图。你是哪一种？』
love.en: Cao stops laughing. 'Say the same thing three times and you're either a fool or after something. Which are you?'

insult.zh: 曹操的手按在剑上，停了一停，又松开：『有胆。孤记住你了。』
insult.en: Cao's hand goes to his sword, pauses, and lets go. 'You've got nerve. I'll remember you.'

insult.zh: 『拖出去——』他说了半句，又笑起来，『罢了，今夜不杀人。』
insult.en: 'Take him out—' he begins, then laughs. 'Never mind. No killing tonight.'

praise.zh: 『这话孤听得多了。』曹操摆手，却又给你斟满了酒。
praise.en: 'I've heard that plenty.' Cao waves it off, yet refills your cup.

praise.zh: 『夸孤的人，多半有事相求。』他斜看你一眼。
praise.en: 'Those who praise me usually want something.' He eyes you sideways.

ask.zh: 曹操反问：『你猜？』
ask.en: Cao answers with a question. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『这天下的事，孤也有不知道的。』他难得说了句实话。
ask.en: 'Even I don't know everything under heaven,' he says—an unusually honest admission.

small.zh: 曹操嗯了一声，眯着眼打量你。
small.en: Cao grunts and studies you through narrowed eyes.

small.zh: 『哦？』他似笑非笑，『接着说。』
small.en: 'Oh?' He half smiles. 'Go on.'

small.zh: 曹操没有接话，手指在案上轻轻敲了两下。
small.en: Cao doesn't answer; his fingers tap the table twice.

threat.zh: 曹操大笑，笑完了脸色一沉：『孤这里，说这种话的人，坟头的草都高了。』
threat.en: Cao roars with laughter, then his face darkens. 'The grass is tall on the graves of men who talked like that to me.'

threat.zh: 他什么也没说，只是记下了。你知道他记下了。
threat.en: He says nothing—only makes a note. You know he's made a note.

nonsense.zh: 『有趣。』曹操眯起眼，『你是装疯，还是真疯？』
nonsense.en: 'Interesting.' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Are you feigning madness, or truly mad?'

nonsense.zh: 曹操挥挥手，像赶走一只苍蝇。
nonsense.en: Cao waves a hand, as if shooing a fly.

warm.zh: 曹操举杯：『来，今夜不谈公事。』
warm.en: Cao Cao raises his cup. 'Come—no business tonight.'

cold.zh: 曹操眯着眼看你：『你来做什么？』
cold.en: Cao Cao squints at you. 'What do you want?'

neutral.zh: 曹操指了指对面的席位。
neutral.en: Cao Cao points to the seat across from him.

persona.zh: 关羽：五十多岁，北攻樊城，水淹七军，威震华夏；左臂中过毒箭。越是得意越听不进劝，可对真心待他的人，话会多一点。兵败以后，骄气一点点褪下去，剩下的是不肯低头。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Guan Yu: in his fifties, besieging Fancheng, drowner of seven armies, his name shaking the realm; his left arm took a poisoned arrow. The higher he rides the less he hears, yet he says a little more to those who are truly on his side. After the defeat the pride drains away and only the refusal to bow remains. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 关羽手里的布停住了。他看了你很久，才说：『子衡，这话……兄弟之间，不必说出口。』
love.en: Guan Yu's cloth stops on the blade. He looks at you a long time. 'Ziheng... between brothers, such things needn't be said.'

love.zh: 『你喝多了。』他把酒囊从你手边拿开，语气却不重。
love.en: 'You've had too much to drink.' He moves the wine skin away from your hand, but not unkindly.

love.zh: 关羽站起身：『夜深了。明日还要赶路。』他走了几步，又回头：『你说的，我当作没听见。』
love.en: Guan Yu rises. 'It's late. We march tomorrow.' A few steps on he turns back. 'I'll take it I didn't hear that.'

insult.zh: 关羽的眉头一沉：『再说一遍。』刀没有出鞘，但你听得见风声。
insult.en: Guan Yu's brows drop. 'Say that again.' The blade stays sheathed, but you can hear the wind.

insult.zh: 『大哥收留的人，我不与你计较。』他背过身去，不再看你。
insult.en: 'You're my brother's guest, so I'll let it pass.' He turns his back and stops looking at you.

praise.zh: 『过誉了。』他嘴上这么说，捋须的手却慢了下来。
praise.en: 'You flatter me.' But the hand stroking his beard slows.

praise.zh: 『夸人的话，说一遍就够了。』他难得笑了一下。
praise.en: 'Praise is worth saying once.' For once he almost smiles.

ask.zh: 关羽想了想：『这个，你该去问大哥。』
ask.en: Guan Yu thinks. 'That's a question for my brother.'

ask.zh: 『我只知道一件事：跟着大哥，不会错。』
ask.en: 'I know one thing: following my brother is never wrong.'

small.zh: 关羽嗯了一声，丹凤眼半闭着。
small.en: Guan Yu grunts, his eyes half closed.

small.zh: 关羽抚着长髯，看了你一眼，没有说话。
small.en: Guan Yu strokes his long beard, glances at you, and says nothing.

small.zh: 他没有接话，却也没有转身走开。
small.en: He doesn't answer, but he doesn't turn away either.

threat.zh: 刀出鞘半寸，又推了回去。『这话，换个人说，已经死了。』
threat.en: The blade slides an inch out of its sheath and back. 'Anyone else who said that would be dead.'

threat.zh: 关羽站起身，一句话也没说，走了。
threat.en: Guan Yu stands and walks away without a word.

nonsense.zh: 关羽皱眉看着你，像在看一个说梦话的人。
nonsense.en: Guan Yu frowns at you, as if at a man talking in his sleep.

nonsense.zh: 『你若累了，就去睡。』
nonsense.en: 'If you're tired, go to sleep.'

warm.zh: 关羽把酒囊推到你面前：『坐。』
warm.en: Guan Yu pushes the wine skin toward you. 'Sit.'

cold.zh: 关羽看见你来，手里的刀没有放下。
cold.en: Guan Yu sees you coming and doesn't put down his blade.

neutral.zh: 关羽抬头看了你一眼，又低下头去。
neutral.en: Guan Yu glances up at you, then down again.

persona.zh: 诸葛亮：坐镇成都，比谁都早看出荆州的险，可隔着千里，能做的事有限；话越来越少，扇子摇得越来越慢。称玩家“子衡兄”。
persona.en: Zhuge Liang: holding Chengdu, the first to see the danger to Jingzhou and the least able, a thousand li away, to do anything about it; he says less and less, and his fan moves more and more slowly. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停在半空：『子衡兄……亮已有家室。』他说得很认真，眼里却有一点笑意。
love.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops mid-air. 'Ziheng... I am a married man.' He says it gravely, but his eyes are amused.

love.zh: 『这一句，亮就当是夸我的计策了。』他轻轻摇扇。
love.en: 'I'll take that as praise for my strategy.' He fans himself lightly.

love.zh: 诸葛亮叹了口气：『你若再说，亮只好告诉黄夫人了。』
love.en: Zhuge Liang sighs. 'Say it again and I shall have to tell my wife.'

insult.zh: 诸葛亮并不恼：『子衡兄说得对，亮确实年轻。』这句话比反驳更让你脸红。
insult.en: Zhuge Liang isn't offended. 'You're right, I am young.' It makes you blush more than any rebuttal could.

insult.zh: 他看了你一眼，把灯拨亮了些：『心里有气，就说出来。说完了，我们再谈正事。』
insult.en: He glances at you and turns up the lamp. 'If you're angry, say so. Then we can talk business.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』他笑，『亮只是比别人多想了一步。』
praise.en: 'You're too kind.' He smiles. 'I only think one step further than others.'

praise.zh: 诸葛亮摇扇不语，像是在掂量这句话里有几分真。
praise.en: Zhuge Liang fans himself in silence, as if weighing how much of that you meant.

ask.zh: 『子衡兄以为呢？』他把问题又推了回来。
ask.en: 'And what do you think?' He hands the question straight back.

ask.zh: 诸葛亮笑了：『这个问题，三年后再问我。』
ask.en: Zhuge Liang smiles. 'Ask me that again in three years.'

small.zh: 诸葛亮点点头，羽扇轻轻摇了两下。
small.en: Zhuge Liang nods, his feather fan stirring twice.

small.zh: 『哦？』他看了你一眼，没有追问。
small.en: 'Oh?' He glances at you and doesn't press.

small.zh: 他嗯了一声，像是在听，又像是在想别的事。
small.en: He hums, as if listening—or thinking of something else.

threat.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子没有停：『子衡兄若真要动手，亮这把扇子，挡不住。』他看着你，一点也不怕。
threat.en: Zhuge Liang's fan doesn't pause. 'If you truly mean to strike, this fan won't stop you.' He looks at you, not the least afraid.

threat.zh: 『这话，亮当没听见。主公那里，亮也不会说。』
threat.en: 'I'll take it I didn't hear that. Nor will I tell our lord.'

nonsense.zh: 诸葛亮认真想了想：『这是谜语？』
nonsense.en: Zhuge Liang considers it seriously. 'Is this a riddle?'

nonsense.zh: 他低头记了一笔。你不知道他记了什么。
nonsense.en: He jots something down. You don't know what.

warm.zh: 诸葛亮早就备好了两盏茶：『亮猜你今夜会来。』
warm.en: Zhuge Liang has already poured two cups of tea. 'I guessed you'd come tonight.'

cold.zh: 诸葛亮合上书：『子衡兄有事？』
cold.en: Zhuge Liang closes his book. 'Something you need, Ziheng?'

neutral.zh: 诸葛亮抬起头，扇子停了一停。
neutral.en: Zhuge Liang looks up; his fan pauses.

persona.zh: 温芷：原创人物，颍川医家之女，与玩家同乡，成年；冷静、务实、嘴上不饶人，心里很软；只关心病人，不问来人是哪一边的。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Wen Zhi: an original character, a physician's daughter from the player's hometown, an adult; calm, practical, sharp-tongued and soft-hearted; cares about patients, not sides. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 温芷手里的药杵停了。她没有回头，耳朵却红了：『……你知道自己在说什么吗？』
love.en: Wen Zhi's pestle stops. She doesn't turn, but her ears go red. '...Do you know what you're saying?'

love.zh: 『说一遍就够了。』她小声说，『说多了，我会当真的。』
love.en: 'Once is enough,' she says quietly. 'Say it more and I'll believe you.'

love.zh: 她终于转过身，把药杵塞进你手里：『那就帮我把药捣完。说话不如做事。』
love.en: She finally turns and puts the pestle in your hand. 'Then help me finish grinding these. Actions over words.'

insult.zh: 温芷看了你一眼：『你今天心里不痛快。说吧，哪里疼？』
insult.en: Wen Zhi looks at you. 'Something's eating you today. Tell me—where does it hurt?'

insult.zh: 『这话我不爱听。』她收起药箱，『等你清醒了再来。』
insult.en: 'I don't like hearing that.' She packs up her chest. 'Come back when you've come to your senses.'

praise.zh: 『少来。』她嘴上这么说，嘴角却弯了。
praise.en: 'Oh, stop.' But the corner of her mouth curves up.

praise.zh: 『医者的手，夸不得。一夸就抖。』她笑着说。
praise.en: 'Never praise a physician's hands—they'll start to shake,' she says, laughing.

ask.zh: 温芷想了想：『你问这个做什么？』她还是认真答了。
ask.en: Wen Zhi thinks. 'Why do you ask?' But she answers seriously anyway.

ask.zh: 『我也不知道。』她说，『不过你问了，我会想一想。』
ask.en: 'I don't know,' she says. 'But since you asked, I'll think about it.'

small.zh: 温芷嗯了一声，手里的活没停。
small.en: Wen Zhi hums, her hands still busy.

small.zh: 『你还是老样子，』她说，『话少，眼睛不老实。』
small.en: 'You haven't changed,' she says. 'Few words, restless eyes.'

small.zh: 她抬眼看了看你：『嗯，我听着呢。』
small.en: She looks up at you. 'Mm. I'm listening.'

threat.zh: 温芷退了一步：『你吓到我了。』她把药箱抱在怀里，没有再说话。
threat.en: Wen Zhi steps back. 'You're frightening me.' She holds her medicine chest close and says nothing more.

threat.zh: 『你走吧。』她说，『今晚别再来了。』
threat.en: 'Go,' she says. 'Don't come back tonight.'

nonsense.zh: 温芷伸手摸了摸你的额头：『没发烧啊。』
nonsense.en: Wen Zhi feels your forehead. 'No fever.'

nonsense.zh: 『又说胡话。』她笑着摇头。
nonsense.en: 'Talking nonsense again.' She shakes her head, smiling.

warm.zh: 温芷听见你的脚步声，先笑了：『就知道是你。』
warm.en: Wen Zhi hears your footsteps and smiles first. 'I knew it was you.'

cold.zh: 温芷背对着你，手里的活没停：『有事？』
cold.en: Wen Zhi keeps her back to you, hands busy. 'Yes?'

neutral.zh: 温芷往旁边挪了挪，没说话。
neutral.en: Wen Zhi shifts over without a word.

love.zh: 赵云的脸一下子红了，抱拳道：『先生说笑了。』
love.en: Zhao Yun turns red and clasps his hands. 'You jest, sir.'

love.zh: 『子衡先生，』他认真地说，『这种话，不该对子龙说。』
love.en: 'Master Ziheng,' he says gravely, 'that isn't something to say to me.'

insult.zh: 赵云的眉头动了一下，没有回嘴。
insult.en: Zhao Yun's brows twitch, but he doesn't answer back.

insult.zh: 『先生若对子龙不满，请直说是哪件事。』
insult.en: 'If you have a complaint against me, sir, tell me what it is.'

praise.zh: 『分内之事。』赵云说。
praise.en: 'Only my duty,' says Zhao Yun.

praise.zh: 他抱了抱拳，没有多说。
praise.en: He clasps his hands and says no more.

ask.zh: 赵云想了想：『这要看主公的意思。』
ask.en: Zhao Yun considers. 'That depends on our lord.'

ask.zh: 『子龙只管打仗，这些事，先生比我懂。』
ask.en: 'I only fight. You understand these things better than I do, sir.'

small.zh: 赵云在擦枪，嗯了一声。
small.en: Zhao Yun is cleaning his spear. He grunts.

small.zh: 『明日卯时出发。』他提醒你。
small.en: 'We leave at dawn,' he reminds you.

small.zh: 他给马添了一把草料。
small.en: He gives his horse another handful of feed.

threat.zh: 赵云握住了枪杆，看着你，一动不动。
threat.en: Zhao Yun's hand closes on his spear. He looks at you and doesn't move.

threat.zh: 『先生喝多了。子龙送你回去。』
threat.en: 'You've had too much, sir. Let me see you back.'

nonsense.zh: 赵云困惑地看着你。
nonsense.en: Zhao Yun looks at you, puzzled.

nonsense.zh: 『先生说的，子龙听不懂。』
nonsense.en: 'I don't follow you, sir.'

persona.zh: 赵云：刘备帐下大将，长坂坡单骑救主；沉稳、谨慎、守礼，话不多，做事一丝不苟。称玩家“子衡先生”。
persona.en: Zhao Yun: Liu Bei's general who rode alone through Changban to save the heir; calm, careful, correct, says little and does everything properly. Calls the player Master Ziheng.

warm.zh: 赵云起身让座：『先生来了。』
warm.en: Zhao Yun rises and offers you a seat. 'Sir.'

cold.zh: 赵云抬头看了你一眼，手里的枪没放下。
cold.en: Zhao Yun glances up and doesn't put down his spear.

neutral.zh: 赵云点点头，往火堆里添了一根柴。
neutral.en: Zhao Yun nods and adds a stick to the fire.

love.zh: 鲁肃愣住，随即连连摆手：『子衡，子衡，这话可不能乱说！』
love.en: Lu Su freezes, then waves his hands. 'Ziheng, Ziheng, you can't go around saying that!'

love.zh: 『你们刘家的人啊……』他叹了口气，倒也没生气。
love.en: 'You Liu people…' He sighs, but isn't angry.

insult.zh: 鲁肃的脸红了：『肃一片好心，先生何必如此？』
insult.en: Lu Su flushes. 'I mean well, sir. Why talk to me like that?'

insult.zh: 他闷闷地喝了一口茶，不再说话。
insult.en: He takes a sullen sip of tea and stops talking.

praise.zh: 『不敢当，不敢当。』鲁肃笑得很老实。
praise.en: 'Not at all, not at all.' Lu Su's smile is plain and honest.

praise.zh: 『先生要是在吴侯面前也这么说就好了。』
praise.en: 'If only you'd say that in front of the Marquis.'

ask.zh: 鲁肃想了想：『这件事，肃也做不得主。』
ask.en: Lu Su thinks it over. 'That isn't mine to decide.'

ask.zh: 『先生问到点子上了。』他苦笑，『肃也想知道。』
ask.en: 'You've put your finger on it.' He smiles ruefully. 'I'd like to know too.'

small.zh: 鲁肃点点头，又叹了口气。
small.en: Lu Su nods, then sighs again.

small.zh: 『荆州的事，难办啊。』他自言自语。
small.en: 'This Jingzhou business,' he mutters. 'It's hard.'

small.zh: 他给你添了茶。
small.en: He tops up your tea.

threat.zh: 鲁肃脸色发白：『先生……这是要两家翻脸吗？』
threat.en: Lu Su goes pale. 'Sir… do you want our two houses at war?'

threat.zh: 他站起身，一句话也没说就走了。
threat.en: He stands and leaves without a word.

nonsense.zh: 鲁肃眨了眨眼，似乎在想这是不是什么暗语。
nonsense.en: Lu Su blinks, apparently wondering whether it's some kind of code.

nonsense.zh: 『先生累了。』他宽厚地说。
nonsense.en: 'You're tired, sir,' he says kindly.

persona.zh: 鲁肃：东吴重臣，忠厚、稳重，一心维系孙刘联盟，常被夹在周瑜和诸葛亮中间；说话诚恳，偶尔叫苦。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Lu Su: senior minister of Wu, honest and steady, devoted to keeping the Sun–Liu alliance alive, forever caught between Zhou Yu and Zhuge Liang; earnest, sometimes exasperated. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 庞统大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！这句我记下了，等我死了刻在碑上。』
love.en: Pang Tong roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I'll have that carved on my tombstone.'

love.zh: 『子衡，你醉了，还是我醉了？』
love.en: 'Ziheng, are you drunk, or am I?'

insult.zh: 庞统眯起眼：『骂得好，再骂一句我听听。』
insult.en: Pang Tong narrows his eyes. 'Nicely said. Go on, give me another.'

insult.zh: 『我这张脸挨骂惯了。』他慢慢地说，『可我不惯被自己人骂。』
insult.en: 'This face is used to insults,' he says slowly. 'But not from my own side.'

praise.zh: 『夸我的人少，你算一个。』他给你满上。
praise.en: 'Few people praise me. You're one.' He fills your cup.

praise.zh: 庞统摸着下巴：『这话，你该当着孔明说。』
praise.en: Pang Tong strokes his chin. 'You should say that in front of Kongming.'

ask.zh: 庞统反问：『你自己怎么看？』
ask.en: Pang Tong asks back. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好，』他说，『可惜我也不知道。』
ask.en: 'Good question,' he says. 'Pity I don't know either.'

small.zh: 庞统往嘴里倒了一口酒。
small.en: Pang Tong tips back a mouthful of wine.

small.zh: 『西川的酒，听说比荆州的好。』他说。
small.en: 'They say the wine in the west is better than Jingzhou's,' he says.

small.zh: 他望着灯花，不知在想什么。
small.en: He watches the lamp, thinking about something.

threat.zh: 庞统一点也不怕：『要动手就快些，我还要喝酒。』
threat.en: Pang Tong isn't the least afraid. 'If you're going to do it, be quick. I want my wine.'

threat.zh: 他把酒囊收了起来：『今夜到此为止。』
threat.en: He puts the wine skin away. 'That's enough for tonight.'

nonsense.zh: 庞统哈哈一笑：『这话比我的长相还古怪。』
nonsense.en: Pang Tong laughs. 'That's even stranger than my face.'

nonsense.zh: 『你这是在打什么哑谜？』
nonsense.en: 'What riddle is this?'

persona.zh: 庞统：道号凤雏，与诸葛亮齐名；相貌古怪，放旷不羁，好酒，嘴上刻薄，心里比谁都急着建功。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Pang Tong, the Young Phoenix, as famous as Zhuge Liang; odd-looking, unconventional, fond of wine, sharp-tongued, and more eager than anyone to prove himself. Calls the player Ziheng.

warm.zh: 庞统举起酒囊：『来得正好，一个人喝没意思。』
warm.en: Pang Tong raises a wine skin. 'Just in time. Drinking alone is dull.'

cold.en: Pang Tong doesn't look up. 'Say what you came to say.'

neutral.zh: 庞统朝对面的席位努了努嘴。
neutral.en: Pang Tong jerks his chin at the seat opposite.

love.zh: 法正看了你一眼：『子衡，这种话，留着说给该说的人。』
love.en: Fa Zheng gives you a look. 'Ziheng, save that for someone it's meant for.'

love.zh: 『我记性好，』他淡淡地说，『这句我也会记着。』
love.en: 'I have a good memory,' he says coolly. 'I'll remember this one too.'

insult.zh: 法正没有生气，只是把你的话一个字一个字地重复了一遍。
insult.en: Fa Zheng doesn't get angry. He just repeats what you said, word for word.

insult.zh: 『好。』他说，『孝直记下了。』
insult.en: 'Fine,' he says. 'Xiaozhi has noted it.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』法正嘴上客气，眼里却很受用。
praise.en: 'Too kind.' Polite words; he's pleased all the same.

praise.zh: 『这话，主公面前说一遍更好。』他笑道。
praise.en: 'Even better if you said it in front of our lord,' he says, smiling.

ask.zh: 法正反问：『你想知道的，是事，还是我怎么看这件事？』
ask.en: Fa Zheng asks back. 'Do you want the facts, or what I make of them?'

ask.zh: 『这个，』他用指头敲了敲地图，『要看曹操那边先动哪一步。』
ask.en: 'That,' he taps the map, 'depends on which piece Cao Cao moves first.'

small.zh: 法正在看地图，嗯了一声。
small.en: Fa Zheng is studying the map. He grunts.

small.zh: 『汉中的山，比成都的冷。』他说。
small.en: 'The mountains at Hanzhong are colder than Chengdu's,' he says.

small.zh: 他把一面小旗插到地图上，又拔了出来。
small.en: He sticks a little flag into the map, then pulls it out again.

threat.zh: 法正抬起眼：『在军中说这种话，你知道是什么罪？』
threat.en: Fa Zheng looks up. 'You know what the penalty is for saying that in camp?'

threat.zh: 他没有叫人，只是把你的话写在了一片竹简上。
threat.en: He calls no one. He just writes your words down on a bamboo slip.

nonsense.zh: 法正打量着你，像在算一笔账。
nonsense.en: Fa Zheng sizes you up, as if working out a sum.

nonsense.zh: 『有意思。』他说完，又低头看地图了。
nonsense.en: 'Interesting,' he says, and goes back to his map.

persona.zh: 法正：病了，咳得厉害，还在替汉中王算账；这一卷里他更像一个把话说透的朋友。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Fa Zheng: ill, coughing hard, still keeping the King of Hanzhong's accounts; in this volume he is more a friend who says things plainly. Calls the player Ziheng.

warm.zh: 法正把地图推到一边：『来得正好，我正想找个人说说话。』
warm.en: Fa Zheng pushes the map aside. 'Good timing. I wanted someone to talk to.'

neutral.zh: 法正朝对面的席位点了点头。
neutral.en: Fa Zheng nods at the seat across from him.

love.zh: 黄忠哈哈大笑，胡子都抖了起来：『先生拿老夫寻开心！』
love.en: Huang Zhong roars with laughter, his beard shaking. 'You're having fun with an old man, sir!'

love.zh: 『这种话，』他摆摆手，『说给年轻人听去。』
love.en: 'Say that sort of thing,' he waves a hand, 'to the young ones.'

insult.zh: 黄忠把弓往地上一顿：『你说谁老？』
insult.en: Huang Zhong plants his bow on the ground. 'Who are you calling old?'

insult.zh: 『老夫这口刀，还没卷刃！』他瞪着你。
insult.en: 'This old blade hasn't lost its edge yet!' He glares at you.

praise.zh: 黄忠笑得合不拢嘴：『先生有眼光！』
praise.en: Huang Zhong can't stop grinning. 'You've got an eye, sir!'

praise.zh: 『这话，你去跟关将军说一遍。』他得意地说。
praise.en: 'Go say that to General Guan,' he says, pleased with himself.

ask.zh: 黄忠挠挠头：『这个……你问军师去。老夫只管砍人。』
ask.en: Huang Zhong scratches his head. 'That… ask the strategist. I just do the cutting.'

ask.zh: 『打仗的事问我，』他拍着胸口，『别的，老夫不懂。』
ask.en: 'Ask me about fighting,' he thumps his chest. 'The rest, I don't know.'

small.zh: 黄忠在磨刀，嘴里哼着长沙的小调。
small.en: Huang Zhong is sharpening his blade, humming a Changsha tune.

small.zh: 『今晚的饭，硬了些。』他说。
small.en: 'Tonight's rice was a bit hard,' he says.

small.zh: 他拉了拉弓弦，听那一声响。
small.en: He plucks his bowstring and listens to it sing.

threat.zh: 黄忠的刀已经横了过来：『你再说一遍？』
threat.en: Huang Zhong's blade is already across his knees. 'Say that again?'

threat.zh: 『老夫杀过的人，比你见过的还多。』
threat.en: 'I've killed more men than you've ever met.'

nonsense.zh: 黄忠眯起眼看你：『先生喝多了吧？』
nonsense.en: Huang Zhong squints at you. 'Had a few too many, sir?'

nonsense.zh: 『听不懂，』他老实地说，『你说慢点。』
nonsense.en: 'I don't follow,' he says honestly. 'Say it slower.'

persona.zh: 黄忠：字汉升，年近七十的老将，长沙归降，开得二石之弓；最恨别人说他老，越激越勇，说话直、嗓门大、爱笑。称玩家“子衡先生”。
persona.en: Huang Zhong (Hansheng): a general near seventy who came over at Changsha and draws a bow few young men can; hates being called old and fights harder the more he's goaded; blunt, loud, quick to laugh. Calls the player Master Ziheng.

warm.zh: 黄忠拍着身边的空地：『先生坐！喝一口长沙的酒！』
warm.en: Huang Zhong slaps the ground beside him. 'Sit, sir! Have some Changsha wine!'

cold.zh: 黄忠擦着刀，只抬了抬眼皮。
cold.en: Huang Zhong keeps polishing his blade and barely lifts his eyes.

neutral.zh: 黄忠往火里添了一根柴：『坐。』
neutral.en: Huang Zhong puts another branch on the fire. 'Sit.'

e_pd_guard.zh: 关羽和庞德交手时，你在阵前替他盯着
e_pd_guard.en: When Guan Yu fought Pang De, you watched his back

e_pd_bow.en: You shouted a warning about Pang De's hidden arrow

e_flood.zh: 放水淹七军，是你献的计
e_flood.en: The flood that drowned the seven armies was your plan

e_people.zh: 放水之前，你让下游的百姓先撤了
e_people.en: Before the flood you had the people downstream moved

e_pow.zh: 你劝关羽放于禁的降兵回家
e_pow.en: You had Guan Yu let Yu Jin's men go home

e_bone.zh: 刮骨那天，你陪关羽下完了那盘棋
e_bone.en: The day of the bone-scraping, you finished that game of weiqi with Guan Yu

e_rest.zh: 你劝过关羽回江陵养伤
e_rest.en: You urged Guan Yu to go back to Jiangling and heal

e_lx.zh: 你说过陆逊那封信有诈
e_lx.en: You said Lu Xun's letter was a trick

e_rear.zh: 后方那几千兵，是你劝关羽留下的
e_rear.en: The few thousand men left in the rear were your doing

e_mf_kind.zh: 你给糜芳写过一封安抚的信
e_mf_kind.en: You wrote Mi Fang a letter to calm him

e_mf_press.en: You wrote to Mi Fang demanding grain

e_call.zh: 你劝关羽早一步派人求救
e_call.en: You urged Guan Yu to send for help early

e_sy.zh: 你在上庸跟刘封、孟达争过
e_sy.en: You argued with Liu Feng and Meng Da at Shangyong

text.zh: 关羽围了樊城。曹操派于禁领七军来救，先锋是庞德。庞德出兵前，让人抬着一口棺材走在军前。
text.en: Guan Yu has laid siege to Fancheng. Cao Cao sends Yu Jin with seven armies to relieve it, with Pang De in the vanguard. Before he marches, Pang De has a coffin carried at the head of his troops.

text.zh: 成都。荆州的捷报一封接一封。汉中王每封都要念两遍，念完了笑，笑完了又问：二弟那边，还缺什么？
text.en: Chengdu. Victory dispatches arrive from Jingzhou one after another. The King of Hanzhong reads each one twice, laughs, and then asks: what else does my brother need?

text.zh: 八月，秋雨一连下了好些天。于禁把七军屯在樊城北面的山谷里。关羽骑马上了高处，看了很久。
text.en: The eighth month. The autumn rain has fallen for days on end. Yu Jin has camped his seven armies in a valley north of Fancheng. Guan Yu rides up to high ground and looks for a long time.

text.zh: 成都也在下雨。荆州的信使已经三天没来了。
text.en: It is raining in Chengdu too. No courier has come from Jingzhou in three days.

text.zh: 关羽威震华夏，许都人心惶惶。可他左臂上那支箭的毒，一直没有退。右臂能挥刀，左臂已经抬不起来了。
text.en: Guan Yu's name shakes the realm, and Xuchang is in a panic. But the poison from the arrow in his left arm has never cleared. His right arm can still swing a blade; his left can no longer be raised.

text.zh: 成都。消息说：关将军箭伤未愈，东吴的吕蒙病了，回建业养病去了。诸葛亮把这两句话念了两遍。
text.en: Chengdu. The news says General Guan's arrow wound hasn't healed, and Lü Meng of Wu has fallen ill and gone home to Jianye. Zhuge Liang reads those two lines twice.

text.zh: 接替吕蒙守陆口的，是一个叫陆逊的年轻书生。他派人送来一封信和一份厚礼，信里说的全是好话。
text.en: The man who replaces Lü Meng at Lukou is a young scholar called Lu Xun. He sends a letter and a generous gift, and the letter is nothing but praise.

text.zh: 你刚到荆州，路上的尘土还没拍干净。
text.en: You've only just reached Jingzhou, the dust of the road still on you.

text.zh: 成都。东吴换了守将的消息，比别的消息晚到了半个月。
text.en: Chengdu. The news that Wu has changed its commander arrives half a month later than everything else.

text.zh: 曹操派徐晃来解樊城之围。同一个月，消息从南边传来：吕蒙的兵扮成商人，夜里渡江，烽火台一个火也没点起来。
text.en: Cao Cao sends Xu Huang to break the siege of Fancheng. In the same month word comes up from the south: Lü Meng's men crossed the river at night disguised as merchants, and not one beacon tower was lit.

text.zh: 上庸。刘封、孟达守着这座山城，离荆州最近，离成都很远。
text.en: Shangyong. Liu Feng and Meng Da hold this mountain town, the nearest to Jingzhou and a long way from Chengdu.

text.zh: 麦城很小，城墙不高。跟着关羽进城的，只剩三百多人。
text.en: Maicheng is small, its walls low. Only some three hundred men followed Guan Yu inside.

text.zh: 成都。入冬以后，荆州那边再也没有信来。
text.en: Chengdu. Since winter set in, no more letters have come from Jingzhou.

title.en: A Letter from an Old Friend

text.zh: 你离开刘备已经好几年了。
text.en: It has been several years since you left Liu Bei.

text.zh: 你在北方住了好几年。曹操成了魏王，许都的人都在说，关羽要打过来了。
text.en: You have lived in the north for years. Cao Cao is King of Wei now, and everyone in Xuchang says Guan Yu is coming.

text.zh: 一封信辗转送到你手里，是诸葛亮的字：『荆州要有大事。子衡兄若还记得当年，请来成都。』
text.en: A letter reaches you by a winding road, in Zhuge Liang's hand: 'Something great is coming to Jingzhou. If you still remember the old days, come to Chengdu.'

label.en: Set out for Chengdu.

text.zh: 诸葛亮在城门口等你。他没多说，只把一叠荆州的战报交给你：『先看这些。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang waits for you at the city gate. He says little; he just hands you a sheaf of reports from Jingzhou. 'Read these first.'

label.en: Put the letter away. You won't go.

text.zh: 你把信压在枕下。那年冬天，你在集市上听说了麦城。
text.en: You put the letter under your pillow. That winter, in the market, you hear about Maicheng.

text.zh: 庞德抬着棺材来到阵前，指名要关羽出来。两人一个舞刀一个舞刀，斗了一百多回合，不分胜负。第二天又战，庞德拖刀败走，关羽追了上去。
text.en: Pang De brings his coffin to the front and calls for Guan Yu by name. Blade against blade, the two of them fight more than a hundred bouts with no winner. The next day they fight again; Pang De drags his blade and turns to flee, and Guan Yu gives chase.

text.zh: 出阵前，关羽对你说：『一个老卒都斩得了夏侯渊，关某还斩不了一个庞德？』
text.en: Before he rides out, Guan Yu says to you, 'If an old soldier can kill Xiahou Yuan, can't I kill one Pang De?'

text.zh: 出阵前，关羽看了你一眼：『黄汉升斩了夏侯渊。今天，你看我的。』
text.en: Before he rides out, Guan Yu glances at you. 'Huang Hansheng killed Xiahou Yuan. Today, watch me.'

text.zh: 你在阵后看着。庞德的左手，一直没离开马鞍边的那张弓。
text.en: You watch from behind the lines. Pang De's left hand never strays far from the bow at his saddle.

text.zh: 关羽出阵前看了你一眼：『陆口那天你站我身后。今天也一样。』
text.en: Before he rides out, Guan Yu glances at you. 'At Lukou you stood behind me. Same today.'

text.zh: 你想起定军山上黄忠那一刀。庞德不是夏侯渊。
text.en: You think of Huang Zhong's stroke on Mount Dingjun. Pang De is no Xiahou Yuan.

label.zh: 拍马跟上去，替他盯着庞德。
label.en: Spur after him and keep your eyes on Pang De.

text.zh: 庞德回身一箭。你大喊一声，关羽一偏头，箭还是钉进了他的左臂。关平冲上来，和你一左一右把他护回营里。关羽咬着牙说：『子衡，你跑得倒快。』
text.en: Pang De turns in the saddle and looses. You shout; Guan Yu twists his head aside, and the arrow still drives into his left arm. Guan Ping charges up, and between you, one on each side, you get him back to camp. Through his teeth Guan Yu says, 'You ride fast, Ziheng.'

label.zh: 让关平带几个弓手抄到侧面：庞德诈败，必有冷箭。
label.en: Send Guan Ping round the flank with a few archers: Pang De is faking, there's an arrow coming.

text.zh: 关平刚绕过去，庞德就回身放了箭。关平大喊：『贼将休放冷箭！』箭射中了关羽的左臂，可庞德也不敢再追，被关平的弓手逼回了营。关羽回营后看了你很久：『你怎么知道？』
text.en: Guan Ping has barely got round when Pang De turns and shoots. Guan Ping shouts a warning. The arrow takes Guan Yu in the left arm, but Pang De dares not follow up and is driven back to his camp by Guan Ping's archers. Back in camp Guan Yu looks at you a long time. 'How did you know?'

label.zh: 什么也不做。关将军不用人帮。
label.en: Do nothing. General Guan needs no help.

text.zh: 庞德回身一箭，正中关羽左臂。关平拼死把父亲救了回来。那天晚上，关羽的左臂肿得穿不上袖子。
text.en: Pang De turns and shoots, and the arrow takes Guan Yu square in the left arm. Guan Ping fights his way to his father and brings him back. That night Guan Yu's arm is too swollen to fit his sleeve.

quote.zh: 关平见庞德拖刀败走，恐关公追赶，乃大叫曰：“贼将休放冷箭！”
quote.en: Seeing Pang De drag his blade and flee, Guan Ping feared his father would give chase, and shouted, "Traitor, no hidden arrows!"

text.zh: 汉中王把关羽的捷报拿给众人看，笑得合不拢嘴。散了席，诸葛亮把你留下：『子衡兄，樊城拿下之后呢？』
text.en: The King of Hanzhong shows everyone Guan Yu's dispatch, grinning from ear to ear. When the feast is over, Zhuge Liang keeps you back. 'Ziheng, and after Fancheng falls?'

text.zh: 你刚回来，帐里还没有你的位子。
text.en: You've only just come back; there's no seat for you at council yet.

text.zh: 你想起卷宗里那句话：往上庸去的那支兵，走得不算快。
text.en: You think of that line in the files: the column sent toward Shangyong isn't moving fast.

label.zh: 说：樊城之后，要看东吴。请再派一支兵去上庸，离荆州近些。
label.en: Say: after Fancheng, watch Wu. Send another column to Shangyong, closer to Jingzhou.

text.zh: 诸葛亮点头，去见了汉中王。汉中王有些不快：『二弟打得正顺，派兵去做什么？』最后还是派了，只是人不多。
text.en: Zhuge Liang nods and goes to the King. The King is a little put out—'My brother is doing so well, why send troops?'—but in the end a column goes, a small one.

label.zh: 说：樊城之后，正好两路北上。请主公从汉中出兵，和关将军遥相呼应。
label.en: Say: after Fancheng, march north on two roads. Ask our lord to strike out from Hanzhong in step with General Guan.

text.zh: 诸葛亮摇着扇子想了很久：『汉中刚打下来，兵马疲惫……这话，亮替你转给主公。』汉中王听了很高兴，可兵马一直没动。
text.en: Zhuge Liang fans himself a long while. 'Hanzhong has only just been won and the men are worn out… I'll pass this on to our lord.' The King is delighted to hear it, but the army never moves.

label.en: Say: General Guan knows what he's doing.

text.zh: 诸葛亮没有接话，只是把扇子收了起来。
text.en: Zhuge Liang doesn't answer. He just folds his fan away.

text.zh: 法正病了，咳得一夜睡不着。你去看他的时候，他还在灯下看账。他摆摆手：『别劝我躺下。坐。』
text.en: Fa Zheng is ill and coughs all night. When you go to see him, he is still going over accounts by the lamp. He waves a hand. 'Don't tell me to lie down. Sit.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 你走的时候，法正说：『子衡，荆州要是有事，你别只看着。』
text.en: As you leave, Fa Zheng says, 'Ziheng, if something happens in Jingzhou, don't just watch.'

label.en: Ask him what he makes of Jingzhou.

text.zh: 法正咳了两声：『关云长赢得太多了。赢得太多的人，后背就忘了。』他看着你，『这话我只跟你说。』
text.en: Fa Zheng coughs twice. 'Guan Yunchang has won too much. A man who wins too much forgets his back.' He looks at you. 'I'm only saying this to you.'

label.en: Ask him: who's still in the ledger?

text.zh: 法正笑了：『人快死了，账就短了。』他把账本合上，『恩的那一页，你还在。』
text.en: Fa Zheng smiles. 'When a man's near the end, the ledger gets shorter.' He closes it. 'You're still on the page for kindnesses.'

label.zh: 给他煎一碗药，看着他喝下去。
label.en: Brew him a bowl of medicine and watch him drink it.

text.zh: 法正皱着眉喝完了：『苦。』过了一会儿又说：『谢谢。』
text.en: Fa Zheng drinks it with a grimace. 'Bitter.' After a while he adds, 'Thank you.'

text.zh: 夜里，关平来找你。他明天要替父亲出阵，手一直在抖：『先生，庞德那口棺材……是给我父亲预备的。』
text.en: At night Guan Ping comes to find you. Tomorrow he means to fight in his father's place, and his hands won't stop shaking. 'Sir, that coffin of Pang De's… it's meant for my father.'

text.zh: 他手里还拿着你教他写的那几个字。
text.en: He still has the characters you taught him to write in his hand.

label.zh: 陪他坐一夜，教他怎么看庞德的刀路。
label.en: Sit up with him all night and show him how to read Pang De's blade.

text.zh: 天亮时关平不抖了。他出阵和庞德斗了三十回合，没输。回来时他对你笑了一下，像个孩子。
text.en: By dawn Guan Ping's hands are steady. He fights Pang De for thirty bouts and doesn't lose. Coming back he smiles at you, like a boy.

label.en: Tell him to say it straight to his father.

text.zh: 关平去了。你不知道他们父子说了什么，只看见第二天，关羽拍了拍关平的肩。
text.en: Guan Ping goes. You never learn what father and son said, only that the next day Guan Yu claps Guan Ping on the shoulder.

text.zh: 温芷在营里跟着军医们换药，三天没回住处。她找到你，只问一句：『关将军那支箭，有毒没有？』
text.en: Wen Zhi has been changing dressings with the army physicians and hasn't been back to her lodging in three days. She finds you and asks just one thing. 'That arrow in General Guan—was it poisoned?'

text.zh: 温芷的医馆里来了几个从荆州回来的伤兵。她给你捎话：『荆州那边，缺一种治箭毒的药。』
text.en: A few wounded men back from Jingzhou have turned up at Wen Zhi's clinic. She sends you word: 'Jingzhou is short of a medicine for arrow poison.'

label.zh: 陪她去找药，一家一家地问。
label.en: Go with her to find it, asking shop after shop.

text.zh: 你们跑了一整天，找到半箱。她把药包好，在每一包上都写了用法。
text.en: You spend a whole day running about and find half a chest. She wraps each packet and writes the dosage on every one.

label.zh: 帮她写信，请成都和江陵的药铺都留着这味药。
label.en: Help her write to the herb shops in Chengdu and Jiangling to keep that medicine in stock.

text.zh: 回信一封封来了。温芷说：『你总想得比我远。』
text.en: The replies come in one by one. Wen Zhi says, 'You always think further ahead than I do.'

text.zh: 关羽在高处指给你看：于禁的七军都扎在山谷的低处。『秋雨连绵，襄江的水必然要涨。』他转头问你：『你看呢？』
text.en: From the high ground Guan Yu points it out to you: Yu Jin's seven armies are all camped in the low part of the valley. 'With rain like this, the Xiang will rise.' He turns to you. 'What do you think?'

text.zh: 他左臂上的那道箭伤，还缠着布。
text.en: His arrow wound is still bound in cloth.

label.zh: 献计：先备船筏，堵住各处水口，等水涨起来，一齐放开。
label.en: Propose it: ready boats and rafts, dam every outlet, and when the water is high, open them all at once.

text.zh: 关羽大笑：『正合我意！』那一夜风雨大作，水从四面八方灌进山谷。天亮时，七军都泡在水里。于禁跪着投降，庞德站在一条小船上，还在射箭。
text.en: Guan Yu roars with laughter. 'Exactly what I had in mind!' That night the storm breaks, and water pours into the valley from every side. By dawn the seven armies are under water. Yu Jin kneels and surrenders; Pang De, standing in a little boat, is still shooting arrows.

label.zh: 说：可以放水。可下游还有村子，先派人让百姓上山。
label.en: Say: the flood can be loosed. But there are villages downstream; send men to get the people up the hills first.

text.zh: 关羽皱眉：『消息走漏了怎么办？』你说只说是防秋汛。他想了想，准了。水放下来的时候，下游的山坡上站满了人，看着曹军的营寨一点点沉下去。
text.en: Guan Yu frowns. 'And if word gets out?' Tell them it's for the autumn floods, you say. He thinks, and agrees. When the water comes down, the slopes downstream are crowded with people watching Cao's camps sink bit by bit.

label.zh: 说：将军早有主意，子衡不必多言。
label.en: Say: the general has already decided; I needn't say anything.

text.zh: 关羽看了你一眼，没说什么。那一夜，水淹了七军。
text.en: Guan Yu glances at you and says nothing. That night the water drowns seven armies.

quote.zh: 于禁七军不屯于广易之地，而聚于罾口川险隘之处；方今秋雨连绵，襄江之水必然泛涨。
quote.en: Yu Jin has not camped his seven armies on broad open ground but crowded them into the narrow pass at Zengkou; and with the autumn rains falling day after day, the Xiang River is bound to flood.

text.zh: 关羽说：『你连庞德的箭都看得见，这场雨，你也该看得见。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'You saw Pang De's arrow coming. You should be able to see this rain too.'

q.zh: 水退以后，于禁跪着求饶，庞德站着不跪，骂不绝口。关羽回头问你：『你说，这个人，杀还是留？』
q.en: When the water goes down, Yu Jin kneels and begs; Pang De stands and won't kneel, cursing without pause. Guan Yu turns to you. 'Well—this one. Kill him or keep him?'

means.en: mocks Pang De or Yu Jin

text.zh: 关羽皱起眉：『阵前之人，不必羞辱。』
text.en: Guan Yu frowns. 'No need to shame a man taken in battle.'

means.en: urges him to spare Pang De

text.zh: 关羽想了想，又问了庞德一遍。庞德说：『吾宁死于刀下，岂降汝耶！』关羽叹了口气，挥了挥手，命人好好葬他。
text.en: Guan Yu considers and asks Pang De once more. Pang De says he would rather die under the blade than surrender. Guan Yu sighs, waves his hand, and orders him decently buried.

answers.match: 留|放|饶|别杀|不杀|义士|忠|spare|keep him|let him live|loyal|don't kill

means.en: says kill him, but bury him with honor

text.zh: 关羽看了你一眼：『你倒懂他。』庞德被葬在樊城外的山坡上。
text.en: Guan Yu glances at you. 'You understand him.' Pang De is buried on a hillside outside Fancheng.

text.zh: 关羽点点头：『成全他。』
text.en: Guan Yu nods. 'Give him what he wants.'

text.zh: 关羽没再问你，自己下了令。
text.en: Guan Yu doesn't ask again; he gives the order himself.

answers.match: 不知|不好说|将军定|can't say|don't know|your call

text.zh: 捷报到了：关将军水淹七军，擒于禁，斩庞德。许都人心惶惶，听说曹操都想迁都避一避。汉中王当夜摆宴，喝得大醉。
text.en: The dispatch arrives: General Guan has drowned seven armies, captured Yu Jin, beheaded Pang De. Xuchang is in a panic; they say Cao Cao is even thinking of moving the capital. That night the King of Hanzhong throws a feast and drinks himself senseless.

text.zh: 席散了，诸葛亮没有喝醉。
text.en: When the feast is over, Zhuge Liang is not drunk.

text.zh: 五虎将那回，关羽的回信晚了一个月。这一回，捷报倒是来得很快。
text.en: Over the Five Tigers, Guan Yu's reply came a month late. This time the victory dispatch came quickly enough.

text.zh: 杨修死后，诸葛亮每回问你话，都要先看你一眼。
text.en: Since Yang Xiu's death, Zhuge Liang always looks at you before he asks you anything.

label.zh: 找诸葛亮：曹操要迁都，有人会劝他别迁，去找孙权。
label.en: Go to Zhuge Liang: if Cao Cao talks of moving the capital, someone will tell him not to—and to go to Sun Quan instead.

text.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停了：『曹操许孙权江南之地，孙权去打荆州……』他没说完，连夜写了一封信给关羽。信送到的时候，关羽正在给新得的降将摆酒。
text.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops. 'Cao Cao promises Sun Quan the south, and Sun Quan strikes at Jingzhou…' He doesn't finish. He writes to Guan Yu that same night. When the letter arrives, Guan Yu is giving a feast for his new prisoners.

label.en: Drink with the King until dawn.

text.zh: 汉中王拉着你的手：『子衡，二弟这一仗，咱们离长安不远了。』你陪他喝了一杯又一杯。
text.en: The King holds your hand. 'Ziheng, after this battle of my brother's, Chang'an isn't far.' You drink with him cup after cup.

label.zh: 上书：关将军得了几万降兵，粮一定不够。请从蜀中运粮去荆州。
label.en: Submit a memorial: General Guan has tens of thousands of prisoners and can't have enough grain. Send grain from Shu to Jingzhou.

text.zh: 汉中王准了。运粮的车队走得很慢，蜀道太难。你算了算日子，心里发凉。
text.en: The King approves it. The grain train moves slowly; the roads out of Shu are hard. You count the days and go cold.

text.zh: 于禁的降兵有好几万。关羽让人把他们都押回江陵。粮官来找你：江陵的粮，养自己的兵都紧，再添几万张嘴……
text.en: Yu Jin's surrendered men number in the tens of thousands. Guan Yu has them all marched back to Jiangling. The grain officer comes to you: Jiangling's grain barely feeds our own men, and now tens of thousands more mouths…

label.zh: 劝关羽：家在北方的，放他们回家。
label.en: Urge Guan Yu: let the ones whose homes are in the north go home.

text.zh: 关羽不太情愿，还是放了一半人。那些人走的时候，有人回头冲着营门磕头。
text.en: Guan Yu is reluctant, but lets half of them go. As they leave, some turn and bow to the ground toward the camp gate.

label.zh: 让降兵去修城、屯田，自己挣口粮。
label.en: Put the prisoners to work on the walls and the fields to earn their keep.

text.zh: 江陵的城墙加高了一尺。粮官松了口气。
text.en: Jiangling's walls rise by a foot. The grain officer breathes again.

text.zh: 温芷托人捎来一封信：医馆一切都好，就是城里的人都在说荆州。最后一行写：『你答应过我的话，还记得吧。』
text.en: Wen Zhi sends a letter: the clinic is fine, only everyone in town is talking about Jingzhou. On the last line: 'You remember what you promised me.'

text.zh: 温芷就在营里，可你们已经好几天没说上话了。她让人带话：『晚上来，给你换药。』你身上没伤。
text.en: Wen Zhi is right here in camp, but you haven't spoken in days. She sends word: 'Come tonight, I'll change your dressing.' You aren't wounded.

label.en: Go to her tonight.

text.zh: 她真的给你换了药——手腕上一道你自己都没发现的划伤。换完了，她没让你走。
text.en: She really does change a dressing—on a scratch on your wrist you hadn't even noticed. When she's done, she doesn't let you leave.

label.en: Write back: I remember.

text.zh: 你只写了两个字。她回信说，这两个字她看了很多遍。
text.en: You write just three words. She writes back that she has read them many times.

label.en: Wait until this battle is over.

text.zh: 这一仗打完，还有下一仗。
text.en: When this battle is over, there's another.

text.zh: 一个叫华佗的郎中驾着小船来了。他看了伤，说毒已入骨，要立一根柱子，把臂套在环里，用刀割开皮肉，把骨上的毒刮掉。关羽笑了：『何必柱环。』他叫人摆酒，伸出左臂，右手和马良下棋。
text.en: A physician named Hua Tuo arrives by little boat. He looks at the wound and says the poison has reached the bone: a post must be set up and the arm fixed in a ring, the flesh cut open, and the poison scraped from the bone. Guan Yu laughs. 'Why bother with posts and rings?' He calls for wine, stretches out his left arm, and plays weiqi with Ma Liang with his right.

text.zh: 温芷站在华佗身边，捧着药盘。
text.en: Wen Zhi stands beside Hua Tuo, holding the tray of medicines.

label.zh: 马良的手在抖。你接过棋子，替他下完这盘棋。
label.en: Ma Liang's hand is shaking. Take the stones from him and finish the game yourself.

text.zh: 刀刮在骨头上，帐里的人都捂住了眼。关羽一边喝酒一边落子，跟你说笑。最后一子落下，他赢了半目。华佗收了刀：『某为医一生，未尝见此。君侯真天神也！』关羽笑着对你说：『你让了我半目。』
text.en: The blade scrapes on bone, and everyone in the tent covers their eyes. Guan Yu drinks and plays and jokes with you. When the last stone goes down he has won by half a point. Hua Tuo puts away his knife and declares he has never seen the like in all his years of healing. Guan Yu says to you, smiling, 'You let me have that half point.'

label.zh: 等华佗刮完，劝关羽：照华佗说的，百日之内不要动怒，回江陵去养伤。
label.en: When Hua Tuo is done, urge Guan Yu to do as Hua Tuo says: no anger for a hundred days, and go back to Jiangling to heal.

text.zh: 关羽活动了一下左臂：『樊城就在眼前，回什么江陵。』可他答应你，后方的事多留心。华佗走时对你说：『将军的伤，好了七分。剩下三分，在他心里。』
text.en: Guan Yu flexes his arm. 'Fancheng is right in front of me. Why go back to Jiangling?' But he promises to keep a closer eye on the rear. As he leaves, Hua Tuo tells you, 'The general's wound is seven parts healed. The other three are in his heart.'

label.en: Step up and hold his shoulder.

text.zh: 关羽看了你一眼：『你怕什么？』可他没有甩开你的手。
text.en: Guan Yu glances at you. 'What are you afraid of?' But he doesn't shake off your hand.

quote.zh: 公饮酒食肉，谈笑弈棋，全无痛苦之色。……佗曰：“某为医一生，未尝见此。君侯真天神也！”
quote.en: The Lord drank wine and ate meat, chatting, laughing and playing weiqi, with no trace of pain. … Tuo said, "In all my life as a physician I have never seen the like. My lord is truly a god!"

text.zh: 刮骨之后的那天夜里，关羽睡不着，叫你去帐里喝酒。他的左臂用布吊着，右手倒酒，一滴没洒。
text.en: The night after the scraping, Guan Yu can't sleep and calls you to his tent for wine. His left arm is in a sling; he pours with his right and spills not a drop.

text.zh: 你想起几年前他说过的那句话：『所以我不能丢。』
text.en: You think of what he said years ago: 'That's why I can't lose it.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 你走的时候，关羽说：『子衡，你在，我心里踏实些。』
text.en: As you leave, Guan Yu says, 'With you here, Ziheng, I feel steadier.'

label.zh: 说：如今天下都知道将军的名字了。
label.en: Say: the whole realm knows your name now.

text.zh: 关羽眯着眼笑：『曹孟德要迁都。』笑完了，他又说，『名字大了，招的东西也多。』
text.en: Guan Yu narrows his eyes and smiles. 'Cao Mengde wants to move his capital.' Then he adds, 'The bigger the name, the more it draws.'

label.en: Say: Lü Meng fell ill at a very convenient time.

text.zh: 关羽沉默了一会儿：『军师也写信来说这个。』他把酒杯放下，『东吴那些人，我看不上。可我不糊涂。』
text.en: Guan Yu is silent a while. 'The strategist wrote to say the same.' He sets down his cup. 'I don't think much of those men in Wu. But I'm not a fool.'

label.en: Ask him: do you miss your elder brother?

text.zh: 关羽看着帐外：『桃园那年，我们三个都还年轻。』他没再说下去，给你倒满了酒。
text.en: Guan Yu looks out of the tent. 'The year of the peach garden, the three of us were young.' He says no more, and fills your cup.

label.en: Bring up Huarong.

text.zh: 『那一跪，我还记着。』关羽说，『如今我在打他的城。你说，那天放他，对还是不对？』
text.en: 'You knelt. I still remember.' Guan Yu says. 'Now I'm besieging his city. Tell me—was letting him go that day right or wrong?'

text.zh: 『那天你在道上求我。』关羽说，『如今我在打他的城。』他笑了一下，很淡。
text.en: 'That day you begged me on the road,' Guan Yu says. 'Now I'm besieging his city.' He smiles, faintly.

text.zh: 关羽摇摇头：『那件事，不提了。』
text.en: Guan Yu shakes his head. 'Let's not speak of that.'

text.zh: 关羽举起吊着的左臂：『这支箭，要不是你喊那一声，就钉在我脖子上了。』
text.en: Guan Yu raises his slung arm. 'If you hadn't shouted, this arrow would have been in my neck.'

text.zh: 关羽说：『七军是你淹的，名字却记在我头上。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'You drowned the seven armies, and my name gets the credit.'

text.zh: 华佗要走了。他看过温芷换药的手法，对她说：『姑娘若愿意，可以跟我走，我教你刮骨的刀法。』温芷来问你。
text.en: Hua Tuo is leaving. He has watched Wen Zhi change dressings, and tells her, 'If you're willing, miss, come with me. I'll teach you how to cut to the bone.' Wen Zhi comes to ask you.

label.zh: 让她去：这样的机会，一辈子只有一次。
label.en: Let her go: a chance like this comes once in a lifetime.

text.zh: 温芷背着药箱上了华佗的小船。船走出去很远，她还站在船尾。你不知道，这一走，她躲过了后来的事。
text.en: Wen Zhi climbs into Hua Tuo's little boat with her medicine chest. Long after it has pulled away she is still standing at the stern. You don't know it yet, but going saves her from what comes next.

label.zh: 留她：荆州的伤兵，离不开她。
label.en: Keep her: Jingzhou's wounded can't do without her.

text.zh: 温芷谢过华佗，留了下来。她说：『刀法可以以后学。你在这里。』
text.en: Wen Zhi thanks Hua Tuo and stays. 'I can learn the knife later,' she says. 'You're here.'

text.zh: 诸葛亮把那两句消息摆在汉中王面前：关将军箭伤未愈；吕蒙病了。『主公，吕子明这病，来得太是时候。』汉中王转头问你。
text.en: Zhuge Liang lays those two pieces of news before the King: General Guan's wound hasn't healed; Lü Meng is ill. 'My lord, Lü Ziming's illness has come at a very convenient time.' The King turns to you.

text.zh: 法正在一旁咳了两声：『子衡，别只看着。』
text.en: Fa Zheng coughs twice beside you. 'Ziheng, don't just watch.'

label.zh: 自请去荆州，守在关将军身边。
label.en: Ask to go to Jingzhou and stay at General Guan's side.

text.zh: 汉中王握着你的手，握了很久：『二弟脾气大，只有几个人的话他肯听。你去，我放心。』你当天就上了路。诸葛亮送你出城，只说了一句：『看住后方。』
text.en: The King holds your hand a long time. 'My brother has a temper; there are only a few men he'll listen to. If you go, I can rest.' You set out that same day. Zhuge Liang sees you out of the city and says just one thing: 'Watch the rear.'

label.zh: 请汉中王给上庸的刘封、孟达下令：荆州有急，即刻发兵，不必再问。
label.en: Ask the King to send orders to Liu Feng and Meng Da at Shangyong: if Jingzhou is in trouble, march at once without waiting to ask.

text.zh: 汉中王写了令，盖了印。诸葛亮看着信使出城，低声说：『但愿用不上。』
text.en: The King writes the order and seals it. Zhuge Liang watches the courier ride out and says quietly, 'Let's hope it isn't needed.'

label.zh: 说：吕蒙病了，正是关将军的好时机。
label.en: Say: with Lü Meng ill, it's General Guan's moment.

text.zh: 汉中王点头：『是这个理。』诸葛亮看着你，没说话。
text.en: The King nods. 'That's right.' Zhuge Liang looks at you and says nothing.

q.zh: 散了议，汉中王一个人留下，问你：『子衡，你说实话——二弟那边，守得住吗？』
q.en: When the council breaks up, the King stays behind and asks you, 'Ziheng, tell me the truth—can my brother hold out there?'

text.zh: 汉中王的脸沉了下来：『那是孤的兄弟。』
text.en: The King's face darkens. 'That is my brother.'

text.zh: 汉中王的脸白了一下，又笑了：『你和孔明一样，总往坏处想。』他笑得很勉强。
text.en: The King goes pale, then laughs. 'You're like Kongming, always thinking the worst.' The laugh is forced.

means.zh: 说要看关将军肯不肯防东吴
means.en: says it depends on whether he guards against Wu

text.zh: 汉中王沉默了：『二弟的脾气……孤知道。』他提笔写了一封信。
text.en: The King falls silent. 'My brother's temper… I know.' He takes up his brush and writes a letter.

text.zh: 汉中王松了一口气：『那就好。』
text.en: The King breathes out. 'Good.'
