text.zh: 汉中王拍了拍你的肩，没有再问。
text.en: The King pats your shoulder and doesn't ask again.

text.zh: 陆逊的信写得很恭敬：说将军威震华夏，说自己年轻无知，请将军多多指教。关羽看完，仰面大笑，把信递给你：『孙权用这样的孺子做将，江东无人了。』
text.en: Lu Xun's letter is deeply respectful: the general's name shakes the realm, the writer is young and ignorant, and begs the general's guidance. Guan Yu reads it, throws back his head and laughs, and hands it to you. 'If Sun Quan has to put a child like this in command, there's no one left in the east.'

text.zh: 他已经下了令：把江陵、公安留守的兵调一大半来樊城。
text.en: He has already given the order: most of the troops left to hold Jiangling and Gong'an are to come north to Fancheng.

text.zh: 孙权求亲那回，是你替关羽挡下了难听的话。东吴没有当场动怒——可这封信，客气得过了头。
text.en: When Sun Quan proposed the match, it was you who kept Guan Yu from saying something ugly. Wu didn't flare up at the time—but this letter is too polite by half.

text.zh: 你想起诸葛瑾的回信：吴侯的脸，不是一封信能补的。
text.en: You remember Zhuge Jin's reply: the Marquis's face can't be mended with a letter.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾被骂走以后，东吴就再没派人来过。直到今天。
text.en: Since Zhuge Jin was cursed out of the hall, Wu hasn't sent anyone. Until today.

text.zh: 他跟你说过：后方的事，多留心。
text.en: He did promise you to keep a closer eye on the rear.

label.zh: 拦住传令的人，跟关羽说：兵可以调，烽火台的人一个也不能少，江陵、公安至少留一半。
label.en: Stop the messenger and tell Guan Yu: move the troops if you must, but not one man off the beacon towers, and leave at least half in Jiangling and Gong'an.

text.zh: 关羽盯着你，盯了很久：『你就这么不放心东吴？』他把令改了。你知道，这改不了什么大局——可要是真有那一天，后方还有几千人能撤出来。
text.en: Guan Yu stares at you for a long time. 'You trust Wu that little?' He changes the order. You know it won't change how things go—but if that day comes, there will still be a few thousand men in the rear who can get out.

hint.zh: 需要关羽肯听你的：信任在「倚重」、看重在「推崇」以上，或刮骨后劝过他留心后方
hint.en: Needs Guan Yu to listen to you: trust at Relied on, esteem at Admired or above, or you urged him to mind the rear after the bone-scraping

label.zh: 说：一个书生写这样的信，是要将军把后背露出来。
label.en: Say: when a scholar writes a letter like this, he wants the general to turn his back.

text.zh: 关羽笑了：『你和军师一样，见什么都怕。』兵还是调走了。
text.en: Guan Yu laughs. 'You're like the strategist—afraid of everything.' The troops go north all the same.

label.en: Say: Lu Xun is just a scholar, true enough.

text.zh: 关羽收了礼物，打发使者回去。那天晚上，江陵、公安的兵开始往北走。
text.en: Guan Yu accepts the gifts and sends the envoy home. That night the troops of Jiangling and Gong'an begin marching north.

quote.zh: 关公览毕，仰面大笑，令左右收了礼物，发付使者回去。
quote.en: When the Lord had read it, he threw back his head and laughed, had his attendants take the gifts, and sent the envoy back.

text.zh: 关羽把信放下：『你上回让我留心后方。』他想了想，没有马上下令。
text.en: Guan Yu puts the letter down. 'Last time you told me to mind the rear.' He thinks, and doesn't give the order at once.

text.zh: 樊城前线缺粮。关羽让人去江陵、公安催粮，话说得很重：『粮不到，回来再与你们算账。』糜芳守江陵，傅士仁守公安。传令的人要走了，你还来得及捎一封信。
text.en: The front at Fancheng is short of grain. Guan Yu sends to Jiangling and Gong'an to hurry it, in harsh words: 'If the grain doesn't come, I'll settle with you when I get back.' Mi Fang holds Jiangling, Fu Shiren holds Gong'an. The messenger is about to leave; you still have time to send a letter with him.

text.zh: 你想起糜芳红着眼说：『这些年，只有你把我当自己人。』
text.en: You remember Mi Fang, red-eyed, saying, 'All these years, you're the only one who's treated me as one of us.'

text.zh: 糜芳挨的那四十棍，还没好利索。
text.en: The forty strokes Mi Fang took haven't fully healed.

text.zh: 糜芳从关羽帐里出来那天，看见了站在门口的你。
text.en: The day Mi Fang came out of Guan Yu's tent, he saw you standing at the door.

label.zh: 写信安抚他：粮能送多少送多少，等将军回来，你替他说话。
label.en: Write to calm him: send what grain he can, and when the general comes back, you'll speak for him.

text.zh: 回信没有来。可后来你才知道，那封信糜芳看了很多遍。
text.en: No reply comes. Only later do you learn that Mi Fang read the letter many times.

label.zh: 写信安抚他：粮能送多少送多少，等将军回来，你替他说话。
label.en: Write to calm him: send what grain he can, and when the general comes back, you'll speak for him.

text.zh: 回信没有来。你和糜芳，到底没有那么熟。
text.en: No reply comes. You and Mi Fang were never really that close.

label.zh: 照将军的意思，再催一遍。
label.en: Write as the general wants: hurry him again.

text.zh: 信送走了。你听说糜芳看完，把信撕了。
text.en: The letter goes. You hear that Mi Fang read it and tore it up.

label.zh: 劝关羽：换一个人去守江陵。
label.en: Urge Guan Yu: send someone else to hold Jiangling.

text.zh: 关羽把手里的笔放下：『临阵换将，前线的兵怎么想？』他没换。可他记住了你的话。
text.en: Guan Yu puts down his brush. 'Change commanders mid-campaign? What will the men at the front think?' He doesn't. But he remembers what you said.

text.zh: 江陵城里，放回家的降兵空出来的营房，住进了从北边逃来的百姓。
text.en: In Jiangling, the barracks left empty by the prisoners you sent home are full of refugees from the north.

text.zh: 东吴换了守将，接替吕蒙的是个书生，叫陆逊。消息晚到了半个月。诸葛亮说：『半个月，够做很多事了。』汉中王问你该怎么办。
text.en: Wu has changed commanders; Lü Meng's replacement is a scholar named Lu Xun. The news is half a month late. Zhuge Liang says, 'Half a month is long enough for a great deal to happen.' The King asks you what to do.

text.zh: 给刘封的令，已经送到上庸了。
text.en: The order to Liu Feng has already reached Shangyong.

label.zh: 自请先去上庸：刘封、孟达那里，得有人盯着。
label.en: Ask to go to Shangyong ahead of time: someone needs to keep an eye on Liu Feng and Meng Da.

text.zh: 你骑马出了成都，一路往东北去。蜀道难，你走了二十多天。
text.en: You ride out of Chengdu, northeast. The roads out of Shu are hard; it takes you more than twenty days.

label.zh: 连夜写信给关羽：陆逊不是书生。
label.en: Write to Guan Yu that same night: Lu Xun is no mere scholar.

text.zh: 信走了。你知道它会到得太晚。
text.en: The letter goes. You know it will arrive too late.

label.zh: 说：关将军不会上这种当。
label.en: Say: General Guan won't fall for that.

text.zh: 汉中王点头。诸葛亮看着窗外，一句话也没说。
text.en: The King nods. Zhuge Liang looks out of the window and says nothing at all.

text.zh: 诸葛亮一个人在书房里，墙上挂着一张旧地图，是隆中那年画的。他听见你进来：『子衡兄，坐。亮今晚不想一个人。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang sits alone in his study. On the wall hangs an old map, drawn the year at Longzhong. He hears you come in. 'Sit, Ziheng. I'd rather not be alone tonight.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 天亮时，诸葛亮说：『荆州要是有事，上庸是最近的一步棋。』
text.en: At dawn Zhuge Liang says, 'If anything happens in Jingzhou, Shangyong is the nearest move on the board.'

label.zh: 问他：隆中那年说的“跨有荆、益”，还算数吗？
label.en: Ask him: what you said at Longzhong—hold both Jing and Yi—does it still stand?

text.zh: 诸葛亮看着地图，很久才说：『荆州一失，那张图就只剩一半。』他把扇子放在图上，正好盖住荆州。
text.en: Zhuge Liang looks at the map a long time before he speaks. 'If Jingzhou is lost, that map is only half a map.' He lays his fan on it, right over Jingzhou.

label.zh: 问他：为什么不亲自去荆州？
label.en: Ask him: why not go to Jingzhou yourself?

text.zh: 诸葛亮苦笑：『主公在汉中，成都要人守。云长……也未必愿意亮去。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang smiles bitterly. 'Our lord is at Hanzhong, and Chengdu needs holding. And Yunchang… might not want me there.'

label.en: Tell him to go to bed.

text.zh: 诸葛亮笑了：『子衡兄也睡不着，才来的吧。』你们就这样坐到了天亮。
text.en: Zhuge Liang smiles. 'You came because you couldn't sleep either, didn't you?' And so you sit together until dawn.

text.zh: 徐晃攻破了围樊城的营寨，关羽带伤上马，箭疮又迸裂了。退兵的路上，消息一个接一个：烽火台被白衣人取了；傅士仁献了公安；糜芳开了江陵的城门。关羽在马上回头看你：『悔不听足下之言，今日果有此事！』
text.en: Xu Huang breaks the siege lines at Fancheng. Guan Yu mounts with his wound still open, and it splits again. On the road back the news comes in blow after blow: the beacon towers were taken by men in white; Fu Shiren has given up Gong'an; Mi Fang has opened the gates of Jiangling. Guan Yu turns in the saddle to look at you.

text.zh: 徐晃攻破了围樊城的营寨，关羽带伤上马，箭疮又迸裂了。退兵的路上，消息一个接一个：烽火台被白衣人取了；傅士仁献了公安；糜芳开了江陵的城门。
text.en: Xu Huang breaks the siege lines at Fancheng. Guan Yu mounts with his wound still open, and it splits again. On the road back the news comes in blow after blow: the beacon towers were taken by men in white; Fu Shiren has given up Gong'an; Mi Fang has opened the gates of Jiangling.

text.zh: 吕蒙进了江陵，不许兵士骚扰随军将士的家小，按月送粮，有病的派医生去看。消息传到军中，兵士们都没了战心，夜里一拨一拨地往南逃。
text.en: Lü Meng has entered Jiangling and forbidden his men to touch the families of the soldiers in Guan Yu's army; he sends them grain every month, and doctors to the sick. When the news reaches the camp, the men lose all will to fight, and slip away south by night in batches.

text.zh: 你劝关羽留下的那几千兵，从江陵撤出来了，正在路上等你们。
text.en: The few thousand men you persuaded Guan Yu to leave behind got out of Jiangling and are waiting for you on the road.

label.zh: 劝关羽：现在就派人去上庸、去成都求救，一刻也别等。
label.en: Urge Guan Yu: send for help to Shangyong and Chengdu right now. Don't wait a moment.

text.zh: 关羽派了廖化去上庸。你写了一封给成都的信，交给一个最快的骑兵。廖化比原来早走了三天——孟达的推辞，还没想好。
text.en: Guan Yu sends Liao Hua to Shangyong. You write a letter to Chengdu and give it to the fastest rider you have. Liao Hua leaves three days earlier than he would have—before Meng Da has his excuses ready.

label.zh: 劝关羽：想走的，让他们走。家在江陵，谁不想回去？
label.en: Urge Guan Yu: let the ones who want to go, go. Their families are in Jiangling—who wouldn't want to go back?

text.zh: 关羽沉默了很久，下了令。那一夜走了一大半。剩下的人，再也没有一个逃的。
text.en: Guan Yu is silent a long time, then gives the order. More than half leave that night. Of those who remain, not one more deserts.

label.zh: 劝他别回江陵，往西走，退回西川再说。
label.en: Urge him not to turn back for Jiangling: go west, back to Shu, and think again there.

text.zh: 关羽勒住马：『荆州是大哥交给我的。我丢了它，有什么脸往西走？』他掉转马头，往南去了。
text.en: Guan Yu reins in. 'Jingzhou was my brother's charge to me. I lost it. With what face do I go west?' He turns his horse south.

quote.zh: 公顾谓司马王甫曰：“悔不听足下之言，今日果有此事！”
quote.en: The Lord turned to his marshal Wang Fu and said, "I regret not heeding your words. Now it has come to this!"

text.zh: 后来有人告诉你：糜芳开城之前，把你那封催粮的信又看了一遍。
text.en: Later someone tells you that before he opened the gates, Mi Fang read your letter demanding grain one more time.

text.zh: 路边有百姓给你们送水。有人认出了你：『放水那天，是先生让我们上的山。』
text.en: People at the roadside bring you water. One of them recognizes you. 'The day of the flood, it was you who sent us up the hills, sir.'

text.zh: 关羽在马上对你说：『陆逊那封信，你说对了。』
text.en: From the saddle Guan Yu says to you, 'Lu Xun's letter—you were right.'

text.zh: 廖化杀出重围，到了上庸，跪着求刘封发兵救麦城。刘封犹豫，孟达在一旁说：『将军以关公为叔，恐关公未必以将军为侄也。』又说山城初附，人心未定，不敢轻动。
text.en: Liao Hua cuts his way out and reaches Shangyong, and on his knees begs Liu Feng to send troops to Maicheng. Liu Feng hesitates. Beside him Meng Da says Liu Feng may count Guan Yu as his uncle, but Guan Yu may not count him as a nephew; besides, this mountain town has only just come over and can't be stirred lightly.

text.zh: 你早几天就到了上庸，孟达的话，你已经听过一遍了。
text.en: You reached Shangyong days ago; you've heard Meng Da say this once already.

text.zh: 汉中王的令就摆在刘封的案上：荆州有急，即刻发兵。
text.en: The King's order lies on Liu Feng's desk: if Jingzhou is in trouble, march at once.

text.zh: 诸葛亮当年派往上庸的那支兵，就驻在城外。
text.en: The column Zhuge Liang sent toward Shangyong back then is camped outside the walls.

label.zh: 当着孟达的面，对刘封说：你父王的令在这里。你不去，我替你去。
label.en: In front of Meng Da, tell Liu Feng: your royal father's order is right here. If you won't go, I'll go in your place.

text.zh: 刘封的脸白了。孟达还要说话，刘封一拍桌子：『点兵！』他给了你两千人。你带着他们连夜往麦城去，廖化在马上哭了。
text.en: Liu Feng goes white. Meng Da starts to speak, and Liu Feng slams the desk. 'Muster the men!' He gives you two thousand. You lead them toward Maicheng that same night; in the saddle, Liao Hua weeps.

hint.zh: 需要你说话有分量：刘备的信任在「倚重」以上，或带着汉中王的令，或早几天就到了上庸
hint.en: Needs your word to carry weight: Liu Bei's trust at Relied on or above, or the King's written order, or arriving at Shangyong days early

label.zh: 不跟他们争了。跟廖化要一匹马，自己去麦城。
label.en: Stop arguing with them. Get a horse from Liao Hua and go to Maicheng yourself.

text.zh: 刘封没有拦你。孟达送你出城，说：『先生是聪明人，何必呢。』你没回头。
text.en: Liu Feng doesn't stop you. Meng Da sees you out of the gate. 'You're a clever man, sir. Why do this?' You don't look back.

label.zh: 和廖化一起回成都求救。
label.en: Go back to Chengdu with Liao Hua to ask for help.

text.zh: 你们日夜不停地赶路。到成都的时候，你知道已经晚了。
text.en: You ride day and night. By the time you reach Chengdu, you know it is too late.

quote.zh: 将军以关公为叔，恐关公未必以将军为侄也。
quote.en: General, you count the Lord Guan as your uncle; I fear the Lord Guan may not count you as his nephew.

text.zh: 一个从江陵逃出来的兵，给你带来温芷的一封信：『吴兵进城了，没有为难医馆，还派人守着门。我很好。你别回来。』
text.en: A soldier who slipped out of Jiangling brings you a letter from Wen Zhi. 'Wu's soldiers have come into the city. They haven't troubled the clinic; they've even put a guard on the door. I'm well. Don't come back.'

label.zh: 托那个兵带一封回信：等我。
label.en: Give the soldier a reply to carry back: wait for me.

text.zh: 那个兵把信揣在怀里，又往南去了。你不知道信送没送到。
text.en: The soldier tucks the letter inside his coat and heads south again. You don't know whether it ever arrived.

label.zh: 回信让她想办法去成都，别等你。
label.en: Write back telling her to find a way to Chengdu and not wait for you.

text.zh: 你在信里写了一条路，从哪里过江，找谁。写完了，你又加了一句：『活着。』
text.en: You write out a route—where to cross, whom to find. When it's done you add one more word: 'Live.'

text.zh: 诸葛瑾进了麦城，劝关羽投降。关羽说：玉可碎而不可改其白，竹可焚而不可毁其节。诸葛瑾满脸羞惭地走了。
text.en: Zhuge Jin comes into Maicheng to urge Guan Yu to surrender. Guan Yu tells him that jade may be shattered but not robbed of its whiteness, bamboo burned but not robbed of its joints. Zhuge Jin leaves, his face burning.

text.zh: 诸葛瑾看见你，苦笑了一下：『又是你。』
text.en: Zhuge Jin sees you and smiles ruefully. 'You again.'

text.zh: 你想起那夜在他房里坐到三更，他说：『明天我就受印。』那时候，他还肯听人把话说完。
text.en: You remember sitting in his room until the third watch, and him saying, 'I'll take the seal tomorrow.' He still let people finish what they were saying, then.

text.zh: 那天夜里，关羽要突围往西川去。北门外有一条大路，一条小路。王甫说小路有埋伏，可走大路。关羽说：『虽有埋伏，吾何惧哉！』他转头看你。
text.en: That night Guan Yu means to break out and make for the west. Outside the north gate there's a main road and a small one. Wang Fu says there will be an ambush on the small road; take the main road. Guan Yu says he fears no ambush. He turns to look at you.

text.zh: 你带来的两千上庸兵，就在城外五里。
text.en: The two thousand men you brought from Shangyong are five li outside the walls.

text.zh: 你一个人骑马赶到了麦城。关羽看见你，愣了一下，笑了：『你来做什么？』
text.en: You've ridden to Maicheng alone. Guan Yu sees you, starts, then smiles. 'What are you doing here?'

text.zh: 糜芳开城那天夜里，托人从小路给你送来一句话：『临沮的小路，别走。』
text.en: On the night he opened the gates, Mi Fang sent a man to you by back roads with a single line: 'Don't take the Linju road.'

text.zh: 从江陵撤出来的那几千兵，守着往西的大路。
text.en: The few thousand men who got out of Jiangling are holding the main road west.

text.zh: 廖化早走了三天。他从上庸回来没有，还没人知道。
text.en: Liao Hua left three days early. Whether he's come back from Shangyong, no one knows yet.

text.zh: 诸葛亮当年派往上庸的那支兵，听说已经过了房陵。
text.en: The column Zhuge Liang sent toward Shangyong long ago is said to be past Fangling already.

label.zh: 拉住他的马：『走大路。等援兵。子衡求将军这一回。』
label.en: Seize his bridle. 'Take the main road. Wait for help. Ziheng begs you, General—this once.'

text.zh: 关羽看着你，看了很久。他慢慢松开了缰绳：『好。这一回，听你的。』
text.en: Guan Yu looks at you for a long, long time. Slowly he lets go of the reins. 'All right. This once, I'll listen to you.'

text.zh: 你们走了大路。天快亮的时候，前面的山口亮起了火把——是自己人。
text.en: You take the main road. Near dawn, torches flare at the pass ahead—your own men.

text.zh: 上庸的两千人从侧面杀出来，冲散了追兵。
text.en: The two thousand from Shangyong come in from the flank and scatter the pursuit.

text.zh: 刘封派出来的一千人，在西边的山口接住了你们。廖化骑在最前面。
text.en: A thousand men sent out by Liu Feng meet you at the western pass, Liao Hua riding at their head.

text.zh: 后来你听说，那一夜，吕蒙的伏兵在临沮的小路上等了一整夜。
text.en: Later you hear that on that night, Lü Meng's ambush waited on the Linju road until morning.

text.zh: 荆州丢了。关羽、关平、周仓，一个都没丢。往西的路上，关羽一直没说话。过了秭归，他忽然说：『子衡，我欠你一条命。』
text.en: Jingzhou is lost. Guan Yu, Guan Ping, Zhou Cang—not one of them is. On the road west Guan Yu says nothing at all. Past Zigui he suddenly says, 'Ziheng, I owe you a life.'

hint.zh: 需要关羽肯听你的（信任在「倚重」或交情在「交好」以上，或你带着援兵赶到），并且至少有两条活路：留兵守后方、糜芳的报信、上庸的援兵、早一步派人求救、早就劝主公派兵往上庸
hint.en: Needs Guan Yu to listen to you (trust at Relied on or friendship at Friends, or you arrive with relief troops) and at least two ways out: troops kept back in the rear, word from Mi Fang, relief from Shangyong, sending for help early, or the column you urged your lord to send toward Shangyong

label.zh: 他要走小路，你就跟着他走小路。
label.en: If he takes the small road, you go down it with him.

text.zh: 小路上果然有伏兵。绊马索一起，关羽从马上摔下来。被押走之前，他回头找到你，只说了一句：『子衡，替我跟大哥说，云长没有降。』后来，孙权没有杀你。他说：留着，让刘备知道。
text.en: There is an ambush on the small road, as Wang Fu said. The tripwires spring and Guan Yu is thrown from his horse. Before they lead him away he looks back, finds you, and says only, 'Ziheng, tell my brother: Yunchang did not surrender.' Afterward Sun Quan does not kill you. Keep him, he says. Let Liu Bei know.

label.zh: 请他写一封信，你从南门突围，去成都。
label.en: Ask him to write a letter; you'll break out by the south gate and make for Chengdu.

text.zh: 关羽在灯下写了很久，写完封好，交到你手里：『这封信，替我交给大哥。』你从南门杀出去的时候，北门那边的火把已经远了。
text.en: Guan Yu writes a long time by the lamp, seals it, and puts it in your hands. 'Give this to my brother for me.' As you fight your way out of the south gate, the torches by the north gate are already far away.

quote.zh: 玉可碎而不可改其白，竹可焚而不可毁其节。……公曰：“虽有埋伏，吾何惧哉！”
quote.en: "Jade may be shattered, but its whiteness cannot be changed; bamboo may be burned, but its joints cannot be broken." … The Lord said, "Ambush or no ambush, what have I to fear?"

text.zh: 关羽笑了笑：『刮骨那天，你让了我半目。今天别让了。』
text.en: Guan Yu smiles a little. 'The day of the scraping, you let me have half a point. Don't let me have anything today.'

text.zh: 关羽说：『那几千人，是你替我留的。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'Those few thousand men—you kept them for me.'

text.zh: 关羽说：『早三天派廖化，是你的主意。』
text.en: Guan Yu says, 'Sending Liao Hua three days early was your idea.'

text.zh: 廖化在你身边，手里还攥着刘封的兵符。
text.en: Liao Hua is beside you, Liu Feng's tally still clenched in his fist.

text.zh: 你想起写给糜芳的那封信。他到底还是开了城门。可他也没忘了你。
text.en: You think of your letter to Mi Fang. He opened the gates in the end. But he didn't forget you.

q.zh: 出城之前，关羽坐在灯下擦刀，忽然问你：『子衡，你说实话——我错在哪里？』
q.en: Before the breakout Guan Yu sits by the lamp cleaning his blade, and suddenly asks, 'Ziheng, tell me the truth—where did I go wrong?'

text.zh: 关羽一言不发，提刀出去了。
text.en: Guan Yu says nothing, takes up his blade and walks out.

answers.match: 活该|蠢|自找|报应|deserve|stupid|your own fault

means.zh: 说错在太骄傲、看轻了东吴
means.en: says pride—he looked down on Wu

text.zh: 关羽擦刀的手停了。过了很久，他说：『这话，只有你敢说。』
text.en: The hand cleaning the blade stops. After a long time he says, 'You're the only one who'd dare say that.'

answers.match: 骄|傲|轻视|看轻|看不起|东吴|吕蒙|陆逊|pride|proud|arrogan|looked down|underestimat|wu

means.zh: 说错在用人：糜芳、傅士仁
means.en: says the men he trusted: Mi Fang and Fu Shiren

text.zh: 关羽冷笑：『那两个人……』笑到一半停住了，『是我把他们逼到那一步的。』
text.en: Guan Yu laughs coldly. 'Those two…' He stops halfway. 'I drove them to it.'

answers.match: 糜芳|傅士仁|用人|部下|mi fang|fu shiren|men|officers

text.zh: 关羽看了你一眼：『你在安慰我。』他把刀插回鞘里，『谢了。』
text.en: Guan Yu glances at you. 'You're comforting me.' He sheathes the blade. 'Thank you.'

answers.match: 没错|没有错|不怪|不是你|天意|nothing wrong|not your fault|fate|no fault

text.zh: 关羽没有追问，只是说：『也是，现在说这些没用了。』
text.en: Guan Yu doesn't press. 'True. No use talking about it now.'

answers.match: 不知|不好说|现在不说|can't say|don't know|not now

text.zh: 成都在望的那天，关羽在马上停了很久：『荆州丢了。我拿什么脸去见大哥？』
text.en: The day Chengdu comes into sight, Guan Yu sits his horse a long while. 'I lost Jingzhou. With what face do I see my brother?'

label.zh: 说：主公要的是二弟，不是荆州。
label.en: Say: our lord wants his brother, not Jingzhou.

text.zh: 关羽没说话，下了马，牵着走完了最后一段路。城门口，刘备没有穿鞋就跑了出来。
text.en: Guan Yu says nothing. He dismounts and leads his horse the last stretch. At the gate Liu Bei comes running out without his shoes.

label.zh: 说：丢了，就再拿回来。可这一回，要先和东吴算清楚。
label.en: Say: what's lost can be taken back. But this time, settle accounts with Wu first.

text.zh: 关羽看着东边，很久才点头：『这笔账，我记着。』你知道，这句话以后会有很多人记着。
text.en: Guan Yu looks east for a long time before he nods. 'I'll remember this account.' You know a great many people will remember those words.

label.en: Say nothing. Stand beside him.

text.zh: 风从东边吹过来。关羽说：『走吧。』
text.en: The wind comes from the east. Guan Yu says, 'Let's go.'

text.zh: 消息是在一个早上到的：关羽父子在临沮被擒，不肯投降，遇害了。汉中王听完，大叫一声，昏了过去。醒来以后，他第一句话是：『孤与东吴，誓不两立！』
text.en: The news arrives one morning: Guan Yu and his son were taken at Linju, would not surrender, and were killed. The King of Hanzhong cries out and falls senseless. When he comes to, his first words are that he and Wu cannot live under the same sky.

text.zh: 你手里还拿着关羽托你带来的那封信。
text.en: You still have the letter Guan Yu gave you to carry.

text.zh: 你没能带兵回来。廖化跪在殿上，哭着说了上庸的事。
text.en: You couldn't bring troops back. Liao Hua kneels in the hall and, weeping, tells what happened at Shangyong.

label.zh: 劝汉中王：仇要报，可不是现在。先稳住，曹丕、孙权都在等我们乱。
label.en: Urge the King: there must be revenge, but not now. Steady first—Cao and Sun are both waiting for us to fall apart.

text.zh: 汉中王瞪着你，眼睛通红：『二弟的仇，等？』诸葛亮在一旁说：『子衡兄说得对。』汉中王没有再说话，可你知道，他没有听进去。
text.en: The King glares at you, eyes red. 'Wait—for my brother's revenge?' Zhuge Liang says beside you, 'Ziheng is right.' The King says nothing more, but you know he hasn't heard.

label.zh: 跪下请命：愿随主公伐吴。
label.en: Kneel and ask for a command: you will follow your lord against Wu.

text.zh: 汉中王扶起你，握着你的手哭了：『好，好。』诸葛亮转过身去。
text.en: The King raises you up, holds your hands, and weeps. 'Good. Good.' Zhuge Liang turns away.

label.zh: 什么也不说，守在他床边。
label.en: Say nothing. Stay by his bed.

text.zh: 汉中王三天没吃东西。你守了三天。第四天，他说：『子衡，你也去睡吧。』
text.en: The King eats nothing for three days. You keep watch for three days. On the fourth, he says, 'Ziheng, you go and sleep too.'

text.zh: 出城之前，你借着灯写了一封信给温芷。写完不知道该交给谁。
text.en: Before the breakout you write a letter to Wen Zhi by lamplight. When it's finished you don't know whom to give it to.

text.zh: 你把麦城的消息写进给温芷的信里，写了又划掉。
text.en: You write the news from Maicheng into a letter to Wen Zhi, then strike it out.

text.zh: 赤壁江边你说过的那句话，她一直记着。
text.en: She has never forgotten what you said by the river after Red Cliffs.

label.zh: 把信揣在怀里：亲手交给她。
label.en: Tuck it inside your coat: you'll hand it to her yourself.

text.zh: 那封信在你怀里揣了很久。
text.en: That letter stays inside your coat a long time.

label.zh: 托一个往南走的商人送去。
label.en: Give it to a merchant heading south.

text.zh: 信送到了。她的回信只有一行：『我等你。』
text.en: The letter arrives. Her reply is a single line: 'I'm waiting for you.'

text.zh: 汉中王已经很久没有问过你了。诸葛亮私下对你说：『子衡兄，主公心里有个结。』
text.en: It's been a long time since the King asked your opinion. Zhuge Liang tells you privately, 'Ziheng, our lord has a knot in his heart.'

label.en: Go to the King and talk it through.

text.zh: 你们谈了一夜。天亮时，汉中王说：『是孤多心了。』
text.en: You talk all night. At dawn the King says, 'I've been too suspicious.'

hint.zh: 需要诸葛亮的看重在「器重」以上、赵云的信任在「可托」以上，或法正的看重在「器重」以上，才有人替你说一句话
hint.en: Needs Zhuge Liang's esteem at Valued or above, Zhao Yun's trust at Reliable or above, or Fa Zheng's esteem at Valued or above, for someone to put in a word for you

label.en: Wait. Do the work in front of you.

text.zh: 议事时，你的位子挪到了后排。
text.en: At council your seat has moved to the back row.

label.en: Take your leave.

text.zh: 汉中王没有留你。
text.en: The King doesn't ask you to stay.

text.zh: 关羽已经好些天没叫你进帐了。关平悄悄对你说：『父亲说，你的话太多。』
text.en: Guan Yu hasn't called you into his tent for days. Guan Ping tells you quietly, 'Father says you talk too much.'

label.en: Go to his tent and apologize to his face.

text.zh: 关羽让你在帐外站了一个时辰，才叫你进去。他没提那些话，只给你倒了一杯酒。
text.en: Guan Yu leaves you standing outside for an hour before calling you in. He doesn't mention what was said; he just pours you a cup.

label.en: Wait for him to cool off.

text.zh: 过了些天，关羽在营门口遇见你，点了点头。仅此而已。
text.en: Some days later Guan Yu passes you at the camp gate and nods. That's all.

label.en: Ask to be sent back to Chengdu.

text.zh: 关羽批了。你走的那天，他没有出来送。
text.en: Guan Yu approves it. The day you leave, he doesn't come out to see you off.

text.zh: 你说中的事情太多了。连东吴都有人在传：刘备手下有个能知未来的人。诸葛亮来找你：『子衡兄，亮不问你从哪里知道的。可孙权会问。』
text.en: You've been right about too many things. Even in Wu people are saying Liu Bei has a man who knows the future. Zhuge Liang comes to you. 'I won't ask how you know, Ziheng. But Sun Quan will.'

label.zh: 从此闭口：只说眼前的事。
label.en: Hold your tongue from now on: speak only of what's in front of you.

text.zh: 你很久没有再说过一句准话。人们慢慢忘了。
text.en: For a long time you say nothing that comes true. People slowly forget.

label.zh: 把实话告诉诸葛亮一个人。
label.en: Tell Zhuge Liang alone the truth.

text.zh: 诸葛亮听完，很久没说话。最后他说：『那么荆州……你早就知道。』
text.en: Zhuge Liang hears you out and is silent a long time. At last he says, 'Then Jingzhou… you knew all along.'

hint.zh: 需要诸葛亮的看重在「器重」以上
hint.en: Needs Zhuge Liang's esteem at Valued or above

label.en: Leave, so your lord isn't tainted by you.

text.zh: 你在一个雨夜出了城。
text.en: You leave the city one rainy night.

text.zh: 你说过的那些话，有人一句句抄了下来，送到了上面。
text.en: Someone has copied down the things you've said, line by line, and sent them up.

label.en: Own it: you spoke out of turn.

text.zh: 没有人罚你。只有一句：『先生是聪明人，聪明人最该管住嘴。』
text.en: No one punishes you. Just one remark: 'You're a clever man. Clever men should mind their tongues most of all.'

label.en: Argue: every word was true.

text.zh: 『有些真话，要挑时候说。』
text.en: 'Some truths need the right moment.'

text.zh: 关羽一掌拍在案上，酒杯跳了起来：『你再说一遍！』周仓已经按住了刀。
text.en: Guan Yu slams his palm on the table and the cups jump. 'Say that again!' Zhou Cang already has his hand on his blade.

label.en: Bow and apologize.

text.zh: 关羽哼了一声，挥手让你下去。
text.en: Guan Yu snorts and waves you away.

label.zh: 不退：『子衡说的，是为将军好。』
label.en: Don't back down: 'What I said, I said for your good, General.'

text.zh: 关羽盯着你看了很久，把手从案上收了回去：『下去吧。』第二天，他派人给你送了一坛酒。
text.en: Guan Yu stares at you a long time, then takes his hand off the table. 'Go.' The next day he sends you a jar of wine.

text.zh: 刘备慢慢放下手里的东西，看着你，很久没有说话。门外，张飞的影子停住了。刘备终于开口，声音很轻：『先生跟了备这些年。这句话，备想听你再说一遍——是醉话，还是真话？』
text.en: Liu Bei slowly sets down what he's holding and looks at you for a long time without a word. Outside the door, Zhang Fei's shadow stops. At last Liu Bei speaks, very quietly. 'You've followed me all these years, sir. I want to hear you say it once more—was that drink talking, or the truth?'

label.en: Kneel: it was drink talking—madness.

text.zh: 刘备扶你起来，拍了拍你的肩：『那就当没说过。』可从那天起，议事的时候，他不再先问你。
text.en: Liu Bei helps you up and pats your shoulder. 'Then it was never said.' But from that day on, in council, he no longer asks you first.

label.zh: 说：是真话——可我想杀的不是你，是那个寄人篱下、什么都不敢做的你。
label.en: Say: it was the truth—but what I want to kill isn't you, it's the you who lives under other men's roofs and dares nothing.

text.zh: 刘备愣住了。半晌，他笑了，眼眶却是红的：『先生这一刀，备受了。』
text.en: Liu Bei is stunned. After a long moment he laughs, though his eyes are red. 'I'll take that cut, sir.'

label.en: Say: it was the truth.

text.zh: 刘备点点头，没有叫张飞进来。他让人给你备了一匹马、一袋盘缠：『先生另择明主吧。备不送了。』那天夜里，你出了城。
text.en: Liu Bei nods and does not call Zhang Fei in. He has a horse and a purse of travel money made ready for you. 'Choose a better lord, sir. I won't see you off.' That night you leave the city.

text.zh: 你没有去成都。麦城的事，是从集市上听来的。
text.en: You never went to Chengdu. You heard about Maicheng in the market.

text.zh: 你在一个雨夜出了城。蜀中又多了一个关于妖人的故事。
text.en: You left the city one rainy night. Shu gained another story about a sorcerer.

text.zh: 你离开了。荆州的结局，你是在路上听说的。
text.en: You left. You heard how Jingzhou ended while you were on the road.

text.zh: 你和关羽一起回到了成都。荆州丢了，人都在。
text.en: You came back to Chengdu with Guan Yu. Jingzhou was lost; the people were not.

text.zh: 临沮的小路上，你一直在他身边。
text.en: On the Linju road, you were at his side to the end.

text.zh: 你从麦城南门杀了出来，怀里揣着一封信。
text.en: You fought your way out of Maicheng's south gate with a letter inside your coat.

text.zh: 你在成都。荆州的消息，你是最后几个知道的。
text.en: You were in Chengdu. You were among the last to hear what happened in Jingzhou.

text.zh: 关羽活着回到了西川。他再也没提过荆州。只有一次，喝醉了，他对你说：『那天你要是没拉住我的马……』
text.en: Guan Yu came back to the west alive. He never spoke of Jingzhou again—except once, drunk, when he said to you, 'If you hadn't caught my bridle that day…'

text.zh: 关羽最后一句话是对你说的：『替我跟大哥说，云长没有降。』你说到了。
text.en: Guan Yu's last words were to you: 'Tell my brother Yunchang did not surrender.' You told him.

text.zh: 关羽的信，刘备看了一夜。信里写了什么，他谁也没告诉。
text.en: Liu Bei read Guan Yu's letter all night. What it said, he told no one.

text.zh: 关羽父子死在临沮。玉泉山上的老僧普静说：『昔非今是，一切休论，后果前因，彼此不爽。』
text.en: Guan Yu and his son died at Linju. On Mount Yuquan the old monk Pujing said: past wrong and present right—speak no more of them; causes and their effects never miss.

text.zh: 汉中王说要伐吴，你是第一个跪下请命的。
text.en: When the King spoke of war on Wu, you were the first to kneel and ask for a command.

text.zh: 你劝汉中王先别报仇。他没听进去，可他记住了是谁劝的。
text.en: You urged the King not to rush into revenge. He didn't listen, but he remembered who had said it.

text.zh: 汉中王没穿鞋就跑出了城门。那天他抱着关羽，哭得像个孩子。
text.en: The King ran out of the gate without his shoes. That day he held Guan Yu and wept like a child.

text.zh: 汉中王最难的那些夜里，叫的是你的名字。
text.en: On the King's hardest nights, it was your name he called.

text.zh: 汉中王待你客气。荆州的事以后，他对谁都客气。
text.en: The King is courteous to you. Since Jingzhou he has been courteous to everyone.

text.zh: 荆州还是丢了。可你劝关羽留下的那几千人，一个个都走回了西川。
text.en: Jingzhou was lost all the same. But the few thousand men you had Guan Yu keep in the rear walked back to the west, every one.

text.zh: 糜芳开了江陵的城门，也托人给你送了一句话。他这辈子，只欠过你一个人的情。
text.en: Mi Fang opened the gates of Jiangling, and he also sent you a word of warning. In all his life, you were the only one he owed.

text.zh: 廖化早走的那三天，后来被人说成是关羽的福气。只有关羽知道，那是谁的主意。
text.en: Those three days Liao Hua gained were later called Guan Yu's luck. Only Guan Yu knew whose idea it had been.

text.zh: 刘封给你的两千人，是那一年唯一从上庸出去的兵。
text.en: The two thousand men Liu Feng gave you were the only troops to leave Shangyong that year.

text.zh: 放水那年让你送上山的百姓，后来年年在山上烧一炷香。
text.en: The people you sent up the hills before the flood burn incense on that hill every year.

text.zh: 吕蒙白衣渡江，荆州一夜易手。烽火台上的火，一个都没有点起来。
text.en: Lü Meng crossed in white, and Jingzhou changed hands in a night. Not one beacon fire was lit.

text.zh: 温芷跟着华佗学刀法。荆州出事那年，她不在荆州。后来她给你写信说：我学会了。
text.en: Wen Zhi went to learn the knife from Hua Tuo. The year Jingzhou fell, she wasn't there. Later she wrote to you: I've learned it.

text.zh: 吴兵在温芷的医馆门口守了一个冬天。开春，她背着药箱，一路走到了成都。
text.en: Wu soldiers guarded the door of Wen Zhi's clinic all winter. In spring she shouldered her medicine chest and walked all the way to Chengdu.

text.zh: 那封信，你后来亲手交给了她。她看完，没有哭，只是抱住了你。
text.en: That letter—later you put it in her hands yourself. She read it and didn't cry; she just held you.

text.zh: 成都城西的小院里，温芷种的当归又开了花。她说，等你回来，就不种药了，种点别的。
text.en: In the little yard on the west side of Chengdu, Wen Zhi's angelica has flowered again. She says when you come home she'll stop growing medicine and grow something else.

text.zh: 温芷在成都的医馆里，收了很多从荆州逃回来的伤兵。
text.en: In her Chengdu clinic, Wen Zhi took in many wounded men who had made it back from Jingzhou.

text.zh: 你很久没有温芷的消息了。
text.en: You haven't heard from Wen Zhi in a long time.

text.zh: 关平活了下来。他后来教自己的孩子写字，从《春秋》抄起。
text.en: Guan Ping lived. Later he taught his own children to write, starting with the Spring and Autumn Annals.

text.zh: 庞德被葬在樊城外的山坡上。是你劝关羽厚葬的。
text.en: Pang De lies on a hillside outside Fancheng. You were the one who had him buried with honor.

text.zh: 放回家的降兵里，有人后来托人带话：家里的地，种上了。
text.en: Of the prisoners sent home, one sent word later: the family fields are planted again.

text.zh: 法正的账本，最后一页写着你的名字，在“恩”那一边。
text.en: On the last page of Fa Zheng's ledger is your name, on the side of kindnesses.

text.zh: 廖化记得上庸那天，是你第一个拍了桌子。
text.en: Liao Hua remembers that at Shangyong, you were the first to slam the table.

text.zh: 蜀中有人说：荆州的事，子衡早就知道。
text.en: In Shu some say Ziheng knew all along what would happen to Jingzhou.

text.zh: 人说子衡口无遮拦。喜欢你的人说你真，怕你的人说你狂。
text.en: People say Ziheng can't hold his tongue. Those who like you call it honesty; those who fear you call it madness.

text.zh: 人说子衡重义。
text.en: People say Ziheng keeps faith.

text.zh: 人说子衡多智，也说子衡心深。
text.en: People say Ziheng is clever, and that his mind runs deep.

text.zh: 史书里没有你的传，只有几处『或曰』。
text.en: The histories give you no biography—just a few lines beginning 'some say.'

text.zh: 说书人讲到麦城，讲不下去了：那一夜，关羽走的是大路。
text.en: When storytellers reach Maicheng, they can't go on: that night, Guan Yu took the main road.

text.zh: 说书人讲到荆州，有好几处讲不顺——那几处，都是你。
text.en: When storytellers reach Jingzhou, several places never quite fit. Those places are you.

text.zh: 荆州归了东吴。刘家离天下最近的那几年，过去了。
text.en: Jingzhou went to Wu. The years when the house of Liu came closest to the realm were over.

garden.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。许都后园，青梅枝从左上探入，远处城墙，右侧小亭中二人对坐煮酒，雷雨将至。图层：雷雨（闪电、雨丝）。
garden.en: Chinese ink wash with light color, wide banner. A walled garden in Xuchang: green-plum branches from the upper left, distant city wall, two men seated drinking in a small pavilion on the right, storm gathering. Layer: storm (lightning, rain).

lamp.zh: 夜，窗格内一灯如豆，一人跪坐读书，窗外竹影。图层：案上一道红色血诏。
lamp.en: Night. Through a lattice window a single lamp, a seated man reading, bamboo shadows outside. Layer: a red silk edict on the desk.

herbs.zh: 药圃，圆形月洞门，竹匾晒药，一名医女。图层：同行男子；春日落花；粉色花瓣（恋爱时刻）。
herbs.en: Herb garden with a round moon gate, bamboo drying trays, a woman physician. Layers: a man beside her; spring blossoms; pink petals (romance moment).

road.zh: 平原大路，行军队列与红旗，远处许都城墙。图层：远处尘土中的追骑。
road.en: A plain with a marching column and red banners, Xuchang's walls in the distance. Layer: pursuing riders in a dust cloud.

letter.zh: 夜，烛光书案，信笺、毛笔、砚台。图层：药包；朱印；窗外江面火光。
letter.en: Night desk by candlelight: letter, brush, inkstone. Layers: medicine packet; red seal; river glow through a window.

hill.zh: 土山被围，山顶一将与两位女眷，山下敌营红旗，一骑来劝降。图层：一骑从山后小路突围。
hill.en: A surrounded earthen hill: a general and two ladies on top, enemy tents with red flags below, a lone rider approaching to parley. Layer: a rider escaping down the back path.

hall.zh: 厅堂内景，梁柱，门外天光。图层：梁上悬印、贴封条的箱笼；一匹赤红骏马。
hall.en: Hall interior, beams and pillars, daylight through the door. Layers: an official seal hanging from a beam and sealed chests; a red warhorse.

camp.zh: 北方营寨，群山，蓝红旗帜林立。
camp.en: A northern army camp among mountains, forests of blue and red banners.

mirror.zh: 竹林溪畔，隐士抚琴，二客远立。
mirror.en: Bamboo grove by a stream, a recluse playing the zither, two visitors standing at a distance.

snow.zh: 雪中茅庐，篱笆，门外数人立雪等候。图层：第四人（徐庶）。
snow.en: A thatched cottage in snow with a fence, several men waiting outside. Layer: a fourth man (Xu Shu).

bridge.zh: 长坂桥，一将横矛立马桥上，桥东树林，百姓奔逃。图层：林中尘土（疑兵）；白袍骑将救人。
bridge.en: Changban bridge: a general with a spear on horseback on the bridge, woods to the east, fleeing civilians. Layers: dust in the woods (feint); a white-robed rider rescuing.

slope.zh: 山坡上曹操与旌旗，坡下枪阵，一白袍将怀抱婴儿突围。图层：阵边缺口中逃出的车辆。
slope.en: Cao Cao and banners on a hilltop, spear ranks below, a white-robed general breaking through with an infant. Layer: carts escaping through a gap.

fog.zh: 大雾江面，远岸营火。图层：插满箭的草船。
fog.en: Fog on the river, distant campfires. Layer: straw boats bristling with arrows.

fire.zh: 赤壁夜江，铁索连舟。图层：火攻与红天；火船；后营空/后营起火；提灯小舟（接人）；下游未连锁的船。
fire.en: Night river at Red Cliffs, ships chained together. Layers: fire and red sky; fire ships; rear camp empty or burning; a small boat with a lantern (rescue); unchained ships downstream.

huarong.zh: 华容道，两侧峭壁，泥泞小路，残兵队列，一将立马拦路。图层：背药箱的女子在队尾。
huarong.en: Huarong road between cliffs, a muddy path, a column of defeated soldiers, a general blocking the way on horseback. Layer: a woman with a medicine chest at the rear.

campfire.zh: 夜营篝火，帐篷剪影，二人对坐火边，火星飞起。图层：城楼（古城）；横在膝上的刀。
campfire.en: A night camp: a fire with sparks, tent silhouettes, two men seated by the fire. Layers: a city wall (Gucheng); a blade across the knees.

riverbank.zh: 战后夜江，水面漂着焦木，远处余火，江边一名女子洗药杵。图层：身旁一名男子。
riverbank.en: The river at night after battle: charred timbers drifting, distant embers, a woman washing a pestle at the water's edge. Layer: a man beside her.

ending.zh: 尾声：晨江远山，红日。图层：两人同舟；江边茅屋炊烟；城郭；独立江岸；梅枝；远帆。
ending.en: Epilogue: river and mountains at dawn, red sun. Layers: two people in a boat; a cottage with smoke; city walls; a lone figure on the shore; plum branch; distant sail.

citywall.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。城墙与城门，城上旗帜。图层：攻城的长梯与枪林；刘字绿旗或东吴红旗；城门洞开；城下人群；黄昏。
citywall.en: Ink and wash, wide. A city wall and gate with banners. Layers: siege ladders and spears; Liu's green banners or Wu's red; open gate; crowd below; dusk.

temple.zh: 山寺，松树，亭台，主客数人。图层：廊下暗藏的刀斧手；被劈开的石头。
temple.en: Hillside temple, pines, pavilions, a few figures. Layers: axemen hidden in the corridor; a split rock.

bigriver.zh: 大江上一艘大船，船上女子与侍从。图层：小船上的武将；怀中孩子；横江拦截的船队与绿旗；东吴的红旗船。
bigriver.en: A large ship on the river, a woman and attendants aboard. Layers: a general on a small boat; a child; a blockade of boats with green banners; Wu's red-bannered ships.

mourning.zh: 夜，灵堂，白幡，灵位与烛火，一人跪拜。图层：两侧吊客；角落一个相貌古怪的人。
mourning.en: Night, a mourning hall, white banners, spirit tablet and candles, one figure kneeling. Layers: mourners on both sides; an odd-looking man in the corner.

ravine.zh: 竹林夹道的山间小路，一骑白马。图层：箭雨；倒地的随从；勒马回头。
ravine.en: A narrow hill path between bamboo, a rider on a white horse. Layers: a hail of arrows; a fallen companion; the rider turning back.

liubei.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，四十岁左右的汉室宗亲，面如冠玉，两耳垂肩，短须，小冠，青灰色交领长袍。表情：平静/温和/冷淡/忧伤/吃惊。
liubei.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: an imperial kinsman around forty, fair face, very long earlobes, short beard, small crown, grey-green crossed-collar robe. Expressions: neutral / warm / cold / sad / surprised.

guanyu.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，面如重枣，丹凤眼，卧蚕眉，长髯过胸，绿头巾，绿袍。表情同上。
guanyu.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: face the deep red of a jujube, phoenix eyes, thick 'silkworm' brows, a beard past the chest, green headscarf and green robe. Same expressions.

caocao.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，丞相，细眼，长须，高冠，深红黑色官袍。表情同上。
caocao.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: the Chancellor, narrow eyes, long thin beard, tall official hat, dark red-black robe. Same expressions.

zhuge.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，二十七岁，纶巾，白色鹤氅，手持羽扇，神情从容。表情同上。
zhuge.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: twenty-seven, silk scholar's cap, white crane-feather cloak, feather fan, composed. Same expressions.

wenzhi.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，原创人物：成年女医者，高髻，金簪，一朵梅花，浅蓝灰衣裙。表情同上，另加害羞。
wenzhi.en: Ink-wash bust portrait, original character: an adult woman physician, high bun, gold hairpin, a plum blossom, pale blue-grey dress. Same expressions plus shy.

zhouyu.zh: 东吴大都督，三十出头，面容俊秀，戴小冠，红色袍服；神情自负。表情：平静、微笑、冷淡、哀伤、吃惊、羞赧。
zhouyu.en: Grand Commander of Wu, early thirties, handsome, small cap, red robes, proud bearing. Moods: neutral, warm, cold, sad, surprised, shy.

lusu.zh: 东吴重臣，中年，短须，忠厚，赭色袍服。
lusu.en: Senior minister of Wu, middle-aged, short beard, honest face, ochre robes.

zhaoyun.zh: 身长八尺，浓眉大眼，阔面重颐（第7回）；银白盔甲，盔顶白缨。
zhaoyun.en: Eight feet tall, thick brows, large eyes, broad face and full jaw (ch. 7); silver-white armour, white plume.

sunfuren.zh: 孙权之妹，成年女子，发髻插金簪红花，红色衣裳，神情刚烈。
sunfuren.en: Sun Quan's sister, an adult woman, hair in a bun with a gold pin and red flowers, red clothes, fierce expression.

pangtong.zh: 浓眉掀鼻，黑面短髯，形容古怪（第57回）；褐色头巾。
pangtong.en: Thick brows, upturned nose, dark face, short beard, odd-looking (ch. 57); brown head scarf.

zhangsong.zh: 额镢头尖，鼻偃齿露，身短不满五尺（第60回）；尖顶小帽。
zhangsong.en: Pointed head, flat nose, protruding teeth, under five feet tall (ch. 60); small pointed cap.

fazheng.zh: 四十岁上下的谋士，面容清瘦，目光锐利，留短须，黑色纶巾，深青色袍服；神情冷静，似笑非笑。
fazheng.en: A strategist around forty, lean face, sharp eyes, short beard, black silk cap, dark teal robes; calm, a half smile.

huangzhong.zh: 年近七十的老将，白发白须，精神矍铄，身材魁梧，金色铠甲，背负大弓，手持大刀；笑容豪爽。
huangzhong.en: A general nearly seventy, white hair and beard, vigorous and broad-shouldered, golden armour, a great bow on his back and a broadsword; a hearty grin.

kept_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，你做到了。她没有说什么，只是把你的手握得很紧。
kept_text.en: You kept your word to Wen Zhi. She says nothing—only holds your hand very tightly.

broken_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，被你自己拿去换了军报。她再提起这句话时，语气平得像在念药方。
broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

kept_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。一卷走完，你还在他身边。
kept_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. At the end of the volume, you're still at his side.

broken_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。后来古城的消息传来，说他听说你留在了曹营，只说了一句：『人各有志。』
broken_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. Word reaches you that when he heard you'd stayed with Cao, he said only: 'Every man chooses his own road.'

kept_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，你守住了。在他那里，这比什么都重。
kept_text.en: You kept the word you gave Guan Yu. To him, nothing weighs more.

broken_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，没有守住。他再也不跟你喝酒了。
broken_text.en: You broke the word you gave Guan Yu. He never drinks with you again.

kept_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠。至少到这一卷为止，你做到了。
kept_text.en: You told Cao Cao you'd serve him faithfully. For this volume at least, you did.

broken_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠，却在长坂坡放走了刘备的家眷。他不知道。你知道。
broken_text.en: You swore loyalty to Cao Cao, then let Liu Bei's people go at Changban. He doesn't know. You do.

desc.zh: 汉中打下来了，你留在汉中王身边。荆州的战报，你每一封都看两遍。
desc.en: Hanzhong is won, and you stayed at the King's side. You read every report from Jingzhou twice.

desc.zh: 关羽北上樊城，你在他的中军帐里。他说，有你在，他心里踏实些。
desc.en: Guan Yu marches on Fancheng, and you're in his headquarters tent. He says that with you there he feels steadier.

desc.zh: 温芷一直在你身边，从赤壁的火，到汉中的山。
desc.en: Wen Zhi has been at your side all along, from the fire at Red Cliffs to the mountains of Hanzhong.

desc.zh: 鸡肋两个字，你听出了一条人命。有人叫你先生，有人叫你妖人。
desc.en: In two words, 'chicken rib', you heard a man's death. Some call you Master; some call you a sorcerer.

desc.zh: 你早早就离开了。汉中和荆州的事，你是从远处听说的。
desc.en: You left early. You heard about Hanzhong and Jingzhou from far away.
